rules.rule_name: Program Initialization on Entry
rules.rule_description: On every entry to the Credit Card Detail screen program, all working storage areas, communication areas, and the return message flag are initialized, and the current transaction ID is set.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
1:Program Initialization
Initialize working storage,
communication areas,
set return message off

acceptance_criteria.Given: The Credit Card Detail screen program is invoked
acceptance_criteria.When: The program begins execution
acceptance_criteria.Then: All working storage areas (CC-WORK-AREA, WS-MISC-STORAGE, WS-COMMAREA) are initialized to their default values, the current transaction ID is set to LIT-THISTRANID in WS-TRANID, and the return message flag (WS-RETURN-MSG) is set to OFF

rules.rule_name: Fresh Session Initialization
rules.rule_description: When the program is invoked for the first time with no prior session data, or when navigating from the main menu without a re-entry flag, all communication areas are reset to start a clean session.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
2:Communication Area Loading
Initialize fresh commarea
for new session

acceptance_criteria.Given: The Credit Card Detail screen program is invoked
acceptance_criteria.When: There is no prior communication area data (EIBCALEN equals zero) OR the calling program is the main menu program (CDEMO-FROM-PROGRAM equals LIT-MENUPGM) AND the program re-entry flag is NOT set (NOT CDEMO-PGM-REENTER)
acceptance_criteria.Then: Both CARDDEMO-COMMAREA and WS-THIS-PROGCOMMAREA are initialized to their default values, clearing any previously stored account ID, card number, and program context

rules.rule_name: Returning Session Data Restoration
rules.rule_description: When the user is returning to the Credit Card Detail screen with an existing session, previously stored data including account ID, card number, and program context are restored from the communication area.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
2:Communication Area Loading
Load stored commarea data
account ID, card number,
program context

acceptance_criteria.Given: The Credit Card Detail screen program is invoked
acceptance_criteria.When: There is prior communication area data (EIBCALEN is not zero) AND the conditions for a fresh start are not met
acceptance_criteria.Then: CARDDEMO-COMMAREA is restored from the first portion of DFHCOMMAREA (length of CARDDEMO-COMMAREA bytes), and WS-THIS-PROGCOMMAREA is restored from the subsequent portion of DFHCOMMAREA (starting after CARDDEMO-COMMAREA, for the length of WS-THIS-PROGCOMMAREA), preserving account ID, card number, and all program context

rules.rule_name: Function Key Capture and PF13-PF24 Mapping
rules.rule_description: The program captures the function key pressed by the user and maps it to a corresponding action indicator. PF13 through PF24 are treated as equivalents to PF01 through PF12 respectively.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
3:PF Key Mapping
Capture function key pressed
Enter or PF3

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user is on the Credit Card Detail screen
acceptance_criteria.When: The user presses any key (ENTER, CLEAR, PA1, PA2, PF1 through PF24)
acceptance_criteria.Then: The corresponding action indicator flag is set: ENTER sets CCARD-AID-ENTER, CLEAR sets CCARD-AID-CLEAR, PA1 sets CCARD-AID-PA1, PA2 sets CCARD-AID-PA2, PF1/PF13 set CCARD-AID-PFK01, PF2/PF14 set CCARD-AID-PFK02, PF3/PF15 set CCARD-AID-PFK03, PF4/PF16 set CCARD-AID-PFK04, PF5/PF17 set CCARD-AID-PFK05, PF6/PF18 set CCARD-AID-PFK06, PF7/PF19 set CCARD-AID-PFK07, PF8/PF20 set CCARD-AID-PFK08, PF9/PF21 set CCARD-AID-PFK09, PF10/PF22 set CCARD-AID-PFK10, PF11/PF23 set CCARD-AID-PFK11, PF12/PF24 set CCARD-AID-PFK12

rules.rule_name: Invalid Key Default to Enter Behavior
rules.rule_description: Only the ENTER key and PF3 are recognized as valid actions on the Credit Card Detail screen. Any other key pressed is overridden and treated as if the user pressed ENTER.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
4:Invalid Key Handling
Default to Enter key
behavior

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user is on the Credit Card Detail screen and has pressed a key
acceptance_criteria.When: The key pressed is neither ENTER (CCARD-AID-ENTER) nor PF3 (CCARD-AID-PFK03)
acceptance_criteria.Then: The key is marked as invalid (PFK-INVALID is TRUE), and the action is overridden to ENTER (CCARD-AID-ENTER is set to TRUE), so the screen processes the input as if the user pressed ENTER

rules.rule_name: PF3 Back Navigation - Determine Return Destination
rules.rule_description: When the user presses PF3 to exit the Credit Card Detail screen, the program determines the correct destination to return to based on whether a calling program and transaction are recorded in the session.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
5:PF3 Exit Navigation
Determine calling program
and transaction to return to

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user is on the Credit Card Detail screen
acceptance_criteria.When: The user presses PF3
acceptance_criteria.Then: If CDEMO-FROM-TRANID is LOW-VALUES or SPACES, the destination transaction is set to LIT-MENUTRANID (main menu transaction); otherwise CDEMO-FROM-TRANID is used as the destination transaction. If CDEMO-FROM-PROGRAM is LOW-VALUES or SPACES, the destination program is set to LIT-MENUPGM (main menu program); otherwise CDEMO-FROM-PROGRAM is used as the destination program. The current transaction ID (LIT-THISTRANID) is recorded as CDEMO-FROM-TRANID, the current program (LIT-THISPGM) is recorded as CDEMO-FROM-PROGRAM, user type is set to CDEMO-USRTYP-USER, program state is set to CDEMO-PGM-ENTER, and the current mapset (LIT-THISMAPSET) and map (LIT-THISMAP) are recorded in CDEMO-LAST-MAPSET and CDEMO-LAST-MAP

rules.rule_name: PF3 Transfer Control to Calling Program
rules.rule_description: After determining the return destination, the program transfers control to the target program passing the full communication area.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
5:PF3 Exit Navigation
Transfer control back
to calling program

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user has pressed PF3 and the return destination program (CDEMO-TO-PROGRAM) has been determined
acceptance_criteria.When: Control transfer is executed
acceptance_criteria.Then: Control is transferred to CDEMO-TO-PROGRAM via XCTL, passing CARDDEMO-COMMAREA as the communication area, and the current program terminates

rules.rule_name: Direct Entry from Credit Card List Screen
rules.rule_description: When the user navigates to the Credit Card Detail screen directly from the Credit Card List screen, the account ID and card number are automatically carried over from the list selection and card data is immediately retrieved without requiring manual entry.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
6:Direct Entry from Card List Screen
Arrive from Credit Card List
with pre-validated account
and card number

acceptance_criteria.Given: The program is in first-entry state (CDEMO-PGM-ENTER is TRUE)
acceptance_criteria.When: The calling program is the Credit Card List program (CDEMO-FROM-PROGRAM equals LIT-CCLISTPGM)
acceptance_criteria.Then: Input status is set to INPUT-OK, CDEMO-ACCT-ID is moved to CC-ACCT-ID-N, CDEMO-CARD-NUM is moved to CC-CARD-NUM-N, card data retrieval is performed (9000-READ-DATA), and the card detail screen is displayed (1000-SEND-MAP)

rules.rule_name: Initial Screen Display on First Entry
rules.rule_description: When the user enters the Credit Card Detail screen for the first time from any source other than the Credit Card List screen, a blank search screen is displayed prompting the user to enter search criteria.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
7:Initial Screen Display
Display credit card detail
search screen prompting
for input

acceptance_criteria.Given: The program is in first-entry state (CDEMO-PGM-ENTER is TRUE)
acceptance_criteria.When: The calling program is NOT the Credit Card List program (CDEMO-FROM-PROGRAM does not equal LIT-CCLISTPGM)
acceptance_criteria.Then: The card detail screen is displayed (1000-SEND-MAP) with empty input fields, prompting the user to enter an Account ID and Card Number

rules.rule_name: User Input Processing on Re-Entry
rules.rule_description: When the user submits data on the Credit Card Detail screen, the inputs are received and validated. If valid, card data is retrieved and displayed; if invalid, the screen is re-displayed with error indicators.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
8:User Input Processing
Receive and validate entered
account and card number

acceptance_criteria.Given: The program is in re-entry state (CDEMO-PGM-REENTER is TRUE), indicating the user has previously seen the screen and submitted data
acceptance_criteria.When: The user presses ENTER to submit the screen
acceptance_criteria.Then: Input processing is performed (2000-PROCESS-INPUTS). If INPUT-ERROR is set, the screen is re-displayed with error highlights (1000-SEND-MAP) and processing returns to await further input. If no INPUT-ERROR, card data retrieval is performed (9000-READ-DATA) followed by screen display (1000-SEND-MAP)

rules.rule_name: User Input Reception from Screen
rules.rule_description: The data entered by the user on the Credit Card Detail search screen is received into the program's input area for subsequent validation and processing.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
21:User Input Reception
Receive data entered by user
from search screen

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user has entered data on the Credit Card Detail screen and pressed ENTER
acceptance_criteria.When: Input processing begins (2000-PROCESS-INPUTS is performed)
acceptance_criteria.Then: The screen data is received from the terminal into CCRDSLAI using the current map (LIT-THISMAP) and mapset (LIT-THISMAPSET), making the entered Account ID (ACCTSIDI) and Card Number (CARDSIDI) available for validation

rules.rule_name: Input Field Normalization - Asterisk and Space Handling
rules.rule_description: Before validation, input fields containing asterisk or space characters are normalized to low-values, treating them as blank/empty entries.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
22:Input Field Normalization
Replace asterisk or space
values with low-values

acceptance_criteria.Given: Screen input has been received into CCRDSLAI
acceptance_criteria.When: Input normalization is performed during edit processing (2200-EDIT-MAP-INPUTS)
acceptance_criteria.Then: If ACCTSIDI of CCRDSLAI equals '*' or SPACES, CC-ACCT-ID is set to LOW-VALUES; otherwise CC-ACCT-ID is set to the value of ACCTSIDI. If CARDSIDI of CCRDSLAI equals '*' or SPACES, CC-CARD-NUM is set to LOW-VALUES; otherwise CC-CARD-NUM is set to the value of CARDSIDI

rules.rule_name: Account Number Blank Validation
rules.rule_description: The Account Number field is validated to ensure it has been provided. If blank or zero, an input error is raised and the user is prompted to enter an account number.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
23:Account Number Validation
Validate account number
provided and numeric

acceptance_criteria.Given: Input normalization has been completed and account validation (2210-EDIT-ACCOUNT) is being performed
acceptance_criteria.When: CC-ACCT-ID equals LOW-VALUES or SPACES, or CC-ACCT-ID-N (numeric form) equals ZEROS
acceptance_criteria.Then: INPUT-ERROR is set to TRUE, FLG-ACCTFILTER-BLANK is set to TRUE, FLG-ACCTFILTER-NOT-OK is set to TRUE, CDEMO-ACCT-ID is set to ZEROES, and if no prior return message exists (WS-RETURN-MSG-OFF), WS-PROMPT-FOR-ACCT is set to TRUE to prompt the user to enter an account number

rules.rule_name: Account Number Numeric Format Validation
rules.rule_description: The Account Number must be a numeric value. If non-numeric characters are entered, an error message is displayed indicating the required format.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
23:Account Number Validation
Validate account number
provided and numeric

acceptance_criteria.Given: The Account Number field (CC-ACCT-ID) is not blank and not zero
acceptance_criteria.When: CC-ACCT-ID contains non-numeric characters (IS NOT NUMERIC)
acceptance_criteria.Then: INPUT-ERROR is set to TRUE, FLG-ACCTFILTER-NOT-OK is set to TRUE, CDEMO-ACCT-ID is set to ZERO, and if no prior return message exists (WS-RETURN-MSG-OFF), the error message 'ACCOUNT FILTER,IF SUPPLIED MUST BE A 11 DIGIT NUMBER' is placed in WS-RETURN-MSG

rules.rule_name: Account Number Valid - Save to Session
rules.rule_description: When the Account Number passes all validation checks, it is saved to the session communication area and marked as valid.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
23:Account Number Validation
Validate account number
provided and numeric

acceptance_criteria.Given: The Account Number field (CC-ACCT-ID) is not blank, not zero, and is numeric
acceptance_criteria.When: Account validation (2210-EDIT-ACCOUNT) completes successfully
acceptance_criteria.Then: CC-ACCT-ID is moved to CDEMO-ACCT-ID in the session communication area, and FLG-ACCTFILTER-ISVALID is set to TRUE

rules.rule_name: Card Number Blank Validation
rules.rule_description: The Card Number field is validated to ensure it has been provided. If blank or zero, an input error is raised and the user is prompted to enter a card number.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
24:Card Number Validation
Validate card number
provided and numeric

acceptance_criteria.Given: Input normalization has been completed and card validation (2220-EDIT-CARD) is being performed
acceptance_criteria.When: CC-CARD-NUM equals LOW-VALUES or SPACES, or CC-CARD-NUM-N (numeric form) equals ZEROS
acceptance_criteria.Then: INPUT-ERROR is set to TRUE, FLG-CARDFILTER-BLANK is set to TRUE, FLG-CARDFILTER-NOT-OK is set to TRUE, CDEMO-CARD-NUM is set to ZEROES, and if no prior return message exists (WS-RETURN-MSG-OFF), WS-PROMPT-FOR-CARD is set to TRUE to prompt the user to enter a card number

rules.rule_name: Card Number Numeric Format Validation
rules.rule_description: The Card Number must be a numeric value. If non-numeric characters are entered, an error message is displayed indicating the required format.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
24:Card Number Validation
Validate card number
provided and numeric

acceptance_criteria.Given: The Card Number field (CC-CARD-NUM) is not blank and not zero
acceptance_criteria.When: CC-CARD-NUM contains non-numeric characters (IS NOT NUMERIC)
acceptance_criteria.Then: INPUT-ERROR is set to TRUE, FLG-CARDFILTER-NOT-OK is set to TRUE, CDEMO-CARD-NUM is set to ZERO, and if no prior return message exists (WS-RETURN-MSG-OFF), the error message 'CARD ID FILTER,IF SUPPLIED MUST BE A 16 DIGIT NUMBER' is placed in WS-RETURN-MSG

rules.rule_name: Card Number Valid - Save to Session
rules.rule_description: When the Card Number passes all validation checks, it is saved to the session communication area and marked as valid.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
24:Card Number Validation
Validate card number
provided and numeric

acceptance_criteria.Given: The Card Number field (CC-CARD-NUM) is not blank, not zero, and is numeric
acceptance_criteria.When: Card validation (2220-EDIT-CARD) completes successfully
acceptance_criteria.Then: CC-CARD-NUM-N (numeric form) is moved to CDEMO-CARD-NUM in the session communication area, and FLG-CARDFILTER-ISVALID is set to TRUE

rules.rule_name: Cross-Field Validation - No Search Criteria Provided
rules.rule_description: After individual field validations, a cross-field check ensures that at least one search criterion has been provided. If both Account Number and Card Number are blank, a no-search-criteria condition is raised.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
25:Cross-Field Validation
Check at least one search
criterion provided

acceptance_criteria.Given: Both Account Number validation (2210-EDIT-ACCOUNT) and Card Number validation (2220-EDIT-CARD) have been performed
acceptance_criteria.When: FLG-ACCTFILTER-BLANK is TRUE AND FLG-CARDFILTER-BLANK is TRUE (both fields were left empty)
acceptance_criteria.Then: NO-SEARCH-CRITERIA-RECEIVED is set to TRUE, indicating the user has not provided any search parameters to retrieve card details

rules.rule_name: Card Record Retrieval by Card Number
rules.rule_description: Card details are retrieved from the CARDDAT file using the Card Number as the primary lookup key.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
9000:Card Record Retrieval
Read card data using
card number as key

acceptance_criteria.Given: Input validation has passed (no INPUT-ERROR) and card data retrieval (9000-READ-DATA / 9100-GETCARD-BYACCTCARD) is initiated
acceptance_criteria.When: The card record lookup is performed against the CARDDAT file (LIT-CARDFILENAME)
acceptance_criteria.Then: The Card Number (CC-CARD-NUM) is used as the record identifier (WS-CARD-RID-CARDNUM) to read the CARD-RECORD from the CARDDAT VSAM file, retrieving the full card record including embossed name, expiry date, and active status

rules.rule_name: Successful Card Record Found
rules.rule_description: When a card record is successfully located in the CARDDAT file, the result is marked as found so the card details can be displayed on screen.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
28:Successful Card Retrieval
Mark result as found cards
for account

acceptance_criteria.Given: A card record lookup has been performed against the CARDDAT file using the Card Number
acceptance_criteria.When: The file read returns a normal (successful) response
acceptance_criteria.Then: FOUND-CARDS-FOR-ACCOUNT is set to TRUE, enabling the card details (embossed name, expiry month, expiry year, active status) to be populated on the display screen

rules.rule_name: Card Record Not Found Handling
rules.rule_description: When no card record is found matching the provided Card Number, an error condition is raised on both the Account and Card Number fields, and a not-found message is displayed to the user.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
27:Card Not Found Handling
Set input error flags
for account and card filters
display not found message

acceptance_criteria.Given: A card record lookup has been performed against the CARDDAT file using the Card Number
acceptance_criteria.When: The file read returns a not-found response (record does not exist)
acceptance_criteria.Then: INPUT-ERROR is set to TRUE, FLG-ACCTFILTER-NOT-OK is set to TRUE, FLG-CARDFILTER-NOT-OK is set to TRUE, and if no prior return message exists (WS-RETURN-MSG-OFF), DID-NOT-FIND-ACCTCARD-COMBO is set to TRUE to display a message indicating the Account/Card combination was not found

rules.rule_name: Screen Header Initialization with Date and Time
rules.rule_description: Every time the Credit Card Detail screen is prepared for display, the screen header is populated with the application titles, current transaction ID, program name, current date in MM/DD/YY format, and current time in HH:MM:SS format.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
9:Screen Initialization
Set up screen header
title, transaction ID,
program name, date, time

acceptance_criteria.Given: The screen is being prepared for display (1100-SCREEN-INIT is performed)
acceptance_criteria.When: Screen initialization executes
acceptance_criteria.Then: The screen output area (CCRDSLAO) is cleared to LOW-VALUES, CCDA-TITLE01 is moved to TITLE01O, CCDA-TITLE02 is moved to TITLE02O, LIT-THISTRANID is moved to TRNNAMEO, LIT-THISPGM is moved to PGMNAMEO, the current date is formatted as MM/DD/YY (WS-CURDATE-MM-DD-YY) and moved to CURDATEO, and the current time is formatted as HH:MM:SS (WS-CURTIME-HH-MM-SS) and moved to CURTIMEO

rules.rule_name: Account ID Field Population on Screen
rules.rule_description: The Account ID field on the screen is populated from the session data. If no account ID is present, the field is cleared.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
10:Account ID Display Setup
Populate account ID field
from communication area

acceptance_criteria.Given: The screen variables are being set up (1200-SETUP-SCREEN-VARS) and EIBCALEN is not zero (returning session)
acceptance_criteria.When: Account ID display setup executes
acceptance_criteria.Then: If CDEMO-ACCT-ID equals zero, ACCTSIDO of CCRDSLAO is set to LOW-VALUES (field cleared); otherwise CC-ACCT-ID is moved to ACCTSIDO of CCRDSLAO to display the account ID

rules.rule_name: Card Number Field Population on Screen
rules.rule_description: The Card Number field on the screen is populated from the session data. If no card number is present, the field is cleared.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
11:Card Number Display Setup
Populate card number field
from communication area

acceptance_criteria.Given: The screen variables are being set up (1200-SETUP-SCREEN-VARS) and EIBCALEN is not zero (returning session)
acceptance_criteria.When: Card Number display setup executes
acceptance_criteria.Then: If CDEMO-CARD-NUM equals zero, CARDSIDO of CCRDSLAO is set to LOW-VALUES (field cleared); otherwise CC-CARD-NUM is moved to CARDSIDO of CCRDSLAO to display the card number

rules.rule_name: Card Details Population on Screen After Successful Retrieval
rules.rule_description: When a card record has been successfully retrieved, the card details including the cardholder name, expiry month, expiry year, and active status are displayed on the screen.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
12:Card Details Display
Populate card holder name,
expiry month, year,
active status

acceptance_criteria.Given: The screen variables are being set up (1200-SETUP-SCREEN-VARS)
acceptance_criteria.When: FOUND-CARDS-FOR-ACCOUNT is TRUE (a card record was successfully retrieved)
acceptance_criteria.Then: CARD-EMBOSSED-NAME is moved to CRDNAMEO of CCRDSLAO, CARD-EXPIRAION-DATE is moved to CARD-EXPIRAION-DATE-X, CARD-EXPIRY-MONTH is moved to EXPMONO of CCRDSLAO, CARD-EXPIRY-YEAR is moved to EXPYEARO of CCRDSLAO, and CARD-ACTIVE-STATUS is moved to CRDSTCDO of CCRDSLAO

rules.rule_name: Default Prompt Message for Input
rules.rule_description: When the screen is displayed for the first time or when there is no informational message to show, the screen defaults to prompting the user to enter their search criteria.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
13:Default Prompt Message
Set prompt to enter
Account and Card Number

acceptance_criteria.Given: The screen variables are being set up (1200-SETUP-SCREEN-VARS)

rules.sub_graph_node_text: Clear all working storage areas

acceptance_criteria.Given: The Credit Card Detail program (CCRDSL) has been invoked and is beginning execution
acceptance_criteria.When: The program starts its initialization sequence
acceptance_criteria.Then: All working storage areas (CC-WORK-AREA and WS-MISC-STORAGE) must be reset to their initial default values, ensuring no stale or residual data from any prior program execution is carried forward into the current session

rules.rule_name: Clear Communication Area Storage at Program Start
rules.rule_description: At the start of the Credit Card Detail program, the communication area working storage (WS-COMMAREA) must be cleared to ensure a clean state before any session data is loaded or exchanged with other programs.

rules.rule_name: Set Return Message to OFF as Default at Program Start

rules.sub_graph_node_text: Set Return Message to OFF by default

acceptance_criteria.Given: The Credit Card Detail program (CCRDSL) has been invoked and the transaction ID has been set

rules.rule_name: Restore Card Number from Prior Session

rules.rule_name: Restore Program Context from Prior Session

rules.sub_graph_node_text:

program context
from prior interaction

acceptance_criteria.Then: The program-specific context data (WS-THIS-PROGCOMMAREA) — containing screen-level state, field validation flags, and any other data specific to the Credit Card Detail screen — is restored from the second segment of the passed communication area, completing the full session restoration

rules.rule_name: Capture and Store User Function Key Input
rules.rule_description: When a user interacts with the Credit Card Detail screen, the system must capture and internally record which function key was pressed so that subsequent processing can determine the appropriate action to take.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Capture the function key pressed by the user from terminal input

acceptance_criteria.Given: A user is on the Credit Card Detail screen and presses any key on the terminal keyboard
acceptance_criteria.When: The system receives the key input from the terminal
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system evaluates the key pressed and stores it as one of the following recognized key identifiers: Enter Key, Clear Key, PA1, PA2, PF1 through PF12 — so that the stored key identifier is available for all subsequent screen processing logic

rules.rule_name: Map Extended Function Keys PF13-PF24 to PF01-PF12 Equivalents
rules.rule_description: The Credit Card Detail screen treats the upper range of function keys (PF13 through PF24) as direct equivalents of PF01 through PF12. This ensures consistent behavior regardless of whether the user presses the primary or secondary set of function keys.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Capture the function key pressed by the user from terminal input

acceptance_criteria.Given: A user is on the Credit Card Detail screen
acceptance_criteria.When: The user presses any function key in the range PF13 through PF24
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system maps and stores the key as its PF01-PF12 equivalent as follows: PF13 is stored as PF01, PF14 as PF02, PF15 as PF03, PF16 as PF04, PF17 as PF05, PF18 as PF06, PF19 as PF07, PF20 as PF08, PF21 as PF09, PF22 as PF10, PF23 as PF11, and PF24 as PF12 — so that the behavior is identical to pressing the corresponding lower-range function key

rules.rule_name: Identify Acceptable Keys for the Credit Card Detail Screen
rules.rule_description: The Credit Card Detail screen only accepts two specific key inputs as valid actions: the Enter key (to submit or confirm) and PF3 (to navigate back). All other keys are considered invalid for this screen and are not accepted as intentional user actions.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Mark key as VALID - Acceptable key for this screen

acceptance_criteria.Given: A user has pressed a key on the Credit Card Detail screen and the key has been captured and stored
acceptance_criteria.When: The system evaluates the stored key identifier against the list of acceptable keys for this screen
acceptance_criteria.Then: If the stored key is the Enter key OR PF3 key, the key is marked as VALID and acceptable for this screen; for all other stored keys including Clear, PA1, PA2, PF1, PF2, PF4 through PF12, the key is marked as INVALID and not acceptable for this screen

rules.rule_name: Override Invalid Key Press to Default Enter Key Behavior
rules.rule_description: When a user presses a key that is not recognized as valid for the Credit Card Detail screen, the system must not halt or produce an error. Instead, it silently overrides the unrecognized key action and defaults to Enter key behavior, ensuring the screen continues to process normally.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Override stored key - Default to Enter Key behavior

acceptance_criteria.Given: A user has pressed a key on the Credit Card Detail screen and the key has been evaluated and marked as INVALID (i.e., it is not the Enter key or PF3)
acceptance_criteria.When: The system checks whether the pressed key is marked as INVALID
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system overrides the stored key identifier and replaces it with the Enter key identifier, so that all subsequent processing treats the user's action as if the Enter key had been pressed

rules.rule_name: Preserve Valid Key Press Without Override
rules.rule_description: When a user presses a key that is recognized as valid for the Credit Card Detail screen (Enter or PF3), the system retains the originally stored key identifier without any modification, ensuring the intended user action is honored.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Keep stored key as is

acceptance_criteria.Given: A user has pressed a key on the Credit Card Detail screen and the key has been evaluated and marked as VALID (i.e., it is the Enter key or PF3)
acceptance_criteria.When: The system checks whether the pressed key is marked as VALID
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system retains the stored key identifier unchanged — Enter key remains as Enter key and PF3 remains as PF3 — so that the correct corresponding action is executed in subsequent processing

rules.rule_description: When a user presses any key on the Credit Card Detail screen, the system identifies and records which specific key was pressed by mapping the physical key input to a logical key indicator. rules.sub_graph_node_text: Key Pressed by User

acceptance_criteria.Given: A user is on the Credit Card Detail screen and presses any key
acceptance_criteria.When: The system captures the key pressed, mapping: ENTER to Enter indicator, CLEAR to Clear indicator, PA1 to PA1 indicator, PA2 to PA2 indicator, PF1-PF12 to their respective PFK01-PFK12 indicators, and PF13-PF24 mapped equivalently to PFK01-PFK12 indicators
acceptance_criteria.Then: The corresponding logical key indicator (CCARD-AID-ENTER, CCARD-AID-CLEAR, CCARD-AID-PA1, CCARD-AID-PA2, CCARD-AID-PFK01 through CCARD-AID-PFK12) is set to TRUE to represent the key that was pressed, and processing continues to key validation

rules.rule_name: Default All Keys to Invalid Before Validation
rules.rule_description: Before evaluating which key was pressed, the system pre-emptively marks the key action as invalid. This ensures that only explicitly supported keys are permitted to drive screen processing, and any unrecognized key is caught by default.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Assume Key is Invalid

acceptance_criteria.Given: A user has pressed a key on the Credit Card Detail screen and the key has been captured and identified
acceptance_criteria.When: The system begins the key validation process
acceptance_criteria.Then: The key validity status is set to INVALID (PFK-INVALID = TRUE) as the default assumption before any further validation is performed

rules.rule_name: Validate Supported Keys - Enter and PF3 Only
rules.rule_description: The Credit Card Detail screen only supports two valid user actions: pressing the ENTER key to submit or process data, and pressing PF3 to navigate back. All other keys are not recognized as valid actions for this screen.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Was Enter or PF3 pressed?

acceptance_criteria.Given: A user has pressed a key on the Credit Card Detail screen and the key validity status has been defaulted to INVALID
acceptance_criteria.When: The system checks whether the key pressed was the ENTER key (CCARD-AID-ENTER is TRUE) OR the PF3 key (CCARD-AID-PFK03 is TRUE)
acceptance_criteria.Then: If the key pressed was ENTER or PF3, the key validity status is updated to VALID (PFK-VALID = TRUE) and normal screen processing continues with the recognized key action

rules.rule_name: Mark Key as Valid and Continue Normal Processing
rules.rule_description: When a supported key (ENTER or PF3) is confirmed as pressed, the system marks the key as valid and allows normal screen processing to proceed with the intended action associated with that key.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Mark Key as Valid Continue with normal processing

acceptance_criteria.Given: A user has pressed either the ENTER key or the PF3 key on the Credit Card Detail screen
acceptance_criteria.When: The system confirms the key is one of the two supported keys (ENTER or PF3)
acceptance_criteria.Then: The key validity status is set to VALID (PFK-VALID = TRUE) and the system proceeds with normal screen processing using the action associated with the pressed key

rules.rule_name: Default Unsupported Key Action to Enter Key Behavior
rules.rule_description: When a user presses any key other than ENTER or PF3 on the Credit Card Detail screen, the system does not reject the interaction. Instead, it silently overrides the unsupported key action and treats it as if the user had pressed the ENTER key, ensuring uninterrupted screen processing.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Default Action to Enter Key Behavior Continue Normal Screen Processing

acceptance_criteria.Given: A user has pressed a key on the Credit Card Detail screen that is not the ENTER key and not the PF3 key (e.g., CLEAR, PA1, PA2, PF1, PF2, PF4 through PF12, or any other function key)
acceptance_criteria.When: The system checks the key validity status and finds it is still INVALID (PFK-INVALID = TRUE), meaning neither ENTER nor PF3 was pressed
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system overrides the key action by setting the ENTER key indicator to TRUE (CCARD-AID-ENTER = TRUE), effectively treating the unsupported key press as an ENTER key press, and normal screen processing continues as if the user had pressed ENTER

rules.rule_name: Determine Destination Transaction on PF3 Exit
rules.rule_description: When the user presses PF3 to exit the Credit Card Detail screen, the system determines which transaction to return to. If no originating transaction is recorded in the session, the user is directed to the Main Menu transaction; otherwise, the user is returned to the transaction that originally called this screen.

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user is on the Credit Card Detail screen and the session context may or may not contain an originating transaction ID (CDEMO-FROM-TRANID)
acceptance_criteria.When: The user presses PF3 (Exit key)
acceptance_criteria.Then: If the originating transaction ID is blank or empty (LOW-VALUES or SPACES), the destination transaction is set to the Main Menu transaction (LIT-MENUTRANID); otherwise, the destination transaction is set to the originating transaction ID (CDEMO-FROM-TRANID) that was recorded when this screen was called

rules.rule_name: Determine Destination Program on PF3 Exit
rules.rule_description: After determining the destination transaction, the system also determines which program to transfer control to. If no originating program is recorded in the session, the user is directed to the Main Menu program; otherwise, the user is returned to the program that originally called this screen.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Was this screen called from another program?

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user has pressed PF3 on the Credit Card Detail screen and the session context may or may not contain an originating program name (CDEMO-FROM-PROGRAM)
acceptance_criteria.When: The destination transaction has been resolved and the system now evaluates the originating program
acceptance_criteria.Then: If the originating program name is blank or empty (LOW-VALUES or SPACES), the destination program is set to the Main Menu program (LIT-MENUPGM); otherwise, the destination program is set to the originating program name (CDEMO-FROM-PROGRAM) that was recorded when this screen was called

rules.rule_name: Update Navigation Context Before PF3 Exit
rules.rule_description: Before transferring control to the destination program, the system records the current screen's identity as the source of this navigation. This ensures the destination program knows where the user came from, enabling correct back-navigation if needed. The current transaction ID, program name, map set, and map name are all recorded in the shared navigation context.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Update Navigation Context
Record current screen as
the source of this navigation

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user has pressed PF3 and the destination transaction and program have been determined
acceptance_criteria.When: The system prepares to transfer control to the destination program
acceptance_criteria.Then: The navigation context is updated so that: the current transaction ID (LIT-THISTRANID) is recorded as the originating transaction (CDEMO-FROM-TRANID), the current program name (LIT-THISPGM) is recorded as the originating program (CDEMO-FROM-PROGRAM), the current map set name (LIT-THISMAPSET) is recorded as the last map set used (CDEMO-LAST-MAPSET), and the current map name (LIT-THISMAP) is recorded as the last map used (CDEMO-LAST-MAP)

rules.rule_name: Set Fresh Entry Mode for Destination Program on PF3 Exit
rules.rule_description: When navigating back via PF3, the destination program must receive the user in a fresh entry state rather than a re-entry state. The user type is also set to standard user. This ensures the destination program presents a clean initial screen rather than attempting to re-process previously submitted data.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Set user navigation state
to fresh entry mode

acceptance_criteria.Given: The navigation context has been updated with the current screen's identity and the destination program has been determined
acceptance_criteria.When: The system is about to transfer control to the destination program
acceptance_criteria.Then: The program entry state is set to fresh entry mode (CDEMO-PGM-ENTER = TRUE) so the destination program treats this as a new entry, and the user type is set to standard user (CDEMO-USRTYP-USER = TRUE)

rules.rule_name: Transfer Control to Destination Program on PF3 Exit
rules.rule_description: As the final step of PF3 exit navigation, the system transfers control directly to the resolved destination program, passing the complete updated navigation context (communication area). This terminates the current screen session and hands off execution to the destination program with all navigation state preserved.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Transfer Control
to Destination Program
with updated navigation context

acceptance_criteria.Given: The destination program (CDEMO-TO-PROGRAM) has been determined, the navigation context has been updated, and the user entry mode has been set to fresh entry
acceptance_criteria.When: The system executes the program transfer
acceptance_criteria.Then: Control is transferred to the destination program (CDEMO-TO-PROGRAM) with the full navigation communication area (CARDDEMO-COMMAREA) passed along, and the current Credit Card Detail screen program terminates its execution

rules.rule_name: Accept Pre-Validated Account and Card Number from Card List Screen
rules.rule_description: When the user navigates to the Card Detail screen directly from the Credit Card List screen, the Account ID and Card Number previously selected on the list screen are automatically carried over into the current screen context without requiring the user to re-enter them.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Accept pre-validated Account ID and Card Number from prior screen context

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user has arrived at the Card Detail screen by navigating from the Credit Card List screen (CDEMO-FROM-PROGRAM equals the Card List program identifier) and the program is in first-entry mode (CDEMO-PGM-ENTER is TRUE)
acceptance_criteria.When: The program initializes the card detail screen for display
acceptance_criteria.Then: The Account ID (CC-ACCT-ID-N) is populated from the session-stored Account ID (CDEMO-ACCT-ID) and the Card Number (CC-CARD-NUM-N) is populated from the session-stored Card Number (CDEMO-CARD-NUM), carrying forward the values selected on the Card List screen

rules.rule_name: Bypass Input Re-Validation for Card List Originated Entry
rules.rule_description: When the Account ID and Card Number are received from the Credit Card List screen, they are treated as already validated and accepted without subjecting them to the standard input validation checks applied to manually entered values.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Mark inputs as valid No re-validation needed

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user has arrived at the Card Detail screen from the Credit Card List screen and the Account ID and Card Number have been accepted from the prior screen context
acceptance_criteria.When: The program prepares to retrieve card data
acceptance_criteria.Then: The input status is immediately set to INPUT-OK (valid), bypassing all account and card number format and content validation checks that would otherwise be applied to user-entered data

rules.rule_name: Retrieve Card Record Using Card Number as Lookup Key
rules.rule_description: The system retrieves the full card record from the Card Data File by using the Card Number as the unique lookup key to obtain all card details associated with that card.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Read Card Record using Card Number as key from Card Data File

acceptance_criteria.Given: The Card Number (CC-CARD-NUM) has been accepted from the Card List screen context and input status is marked as valid
acceptance_criteria.When: The system performs a card data lookup
acceptance_criteria.Then: The Card Number is used as the unique record identifier (WS-CARD-RID-CARDNUM) to read the card record from the Card Data File (CARDDAT), retrieving the full card record (CARD-RECORD) including all card details

rules.rule_name: Mark Card as Found When Record Successfully Retrieved
rules.rule_description: When the card record is successfully located in the Card Data File using the provided Card Number, the system marks the retrieval as successful, enabling the card details to be prepared and presented to the user.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Mark result as Card Found Prepare card details for display

acceptance_criteria.Given: A card lookup has been performed using the Card Number as the key against the Card Data File
acceptance_criteria.When: The Card Data File returns a successful response indicating the card record was found
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system sets the FOUND-CARDS-FOR-ACCOUNT status to TRUE, indicating that valid card details are available and ready to be displayed on the screen

rules.rule_name: Set Error Flags for Both Fields When Card and Account Combination Not Found
rules.rule_description: When the Card Data File does not contain a record matching the provided Card Number, the system flags both the Account ID and Card Number fields as invalid and prepares a user-facing message indicating the account and card combination could not be found.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Set error flags for both Account and Card fields Prepare 'Not Found' message for user

acceptance_criteria.Given: A card lookup has been performed using the Card Number as the key against the Card Data File
acceptance_criteria.When: The Card Data File returns a 'not found' response indicating no matching card record exists for the provided Card Number
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system sets INPUT-ERROR to TRUE, sets FLG-ACCTFILTER-NOT-OK to TRUE for the Account ID field, sets FLG-CARDFILTER-NOT-OK to TRUE for the Card Number field, and — if no prior error message has been set — activates the DID-NOT-FIND-ACCTCARD-COMBO message flag to inform the user that the account and card combination does not exist

rules.rule_name: Display Card Holder Details When Card Record is Found
rules.rule_description: When a card record is successfully retrieved, the system populates the screen with the full set of card holder details including the name embossed on the card, the card's expiration date components, and the current active status of the card.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Display screen with Card Holder Name, Expiry Month, Expiry Year, Card Active Status

acceptance_criteria.Given: The card lookup has returned a successful result and FOUND-CARDS-FOR-ACCOUNT is TRUE
acceptance_criteria.When: The system prepares the card detail screen for display
acceptance_criteria.Then: The screen is populated with the following card details from the retrieved card record: Card Embossed Name (CARD-EMBOSSED-NAME) displayed in the cardholder name field (CRDNAMEO), Card Expiry Month (CARD-EXPIRY-MONTH) displayed in the expiry month field (EXPMONO), Card Expiry Year (CARD-EXPIRY-YEAR) displayed in the expiry year field (EXPYEARO), and Card Active Status (CARD-ACTIVE-STATUS) displayed in the card status field (CRDSTCDO)

rules.rule_name: Highlight Account and Card Fields in Red When Card Combination Not Found
rules.rule_description: When the account and card combination is not found, the system visually highlights both the Account ID and Card Number fields in red on the screen to clearly direct the user's attention to the fields that contain the unresolvable values.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Display screen with error message and red-highlighted fields for user feedback

acceptance_criteria.Given: The card lookup has returned a 'not found' result, INPUT-ERROR is TRUE, FLG-ACCTFILTER-NOT-OK is TRUE, and FLG-CARDFILTER-NOT-OK is TRUE
acceptance_criteria.When: The system prepares the screen attributes for display
acceptance_criteria.Then: The Account ID field (ACCTSIDC in CCRDSLAO) is set to RED color (DFHRED) and the Card Number field (CARDSIDC in CCRDSLAO) is set to RED color (DFHRED), visually indicating to the user that both fields are in error, and the error message describing the not-found condition is displayed in the screen error message area (ERRMSGO)

rules.rule_name: Return Control to Await Next User Action After Card Detail Display
rules.rule_description: After the card detail screen has been sent to the user — whether showing successful card details or an error condition — the system saves the current session state and returns control to CICS, waiting for the user's next interaction with the screen.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Return to await next user action

acceptance_criteria.Given: The card detail screen has been fully prepared and sent to the user terminal, either with card details displayed or with error messages and highlighted fields
acceptance_criteria.When: The screen send operation completes
acceptance_criteria.Then: The current error or return message is moved to the screen error message field (CCARD-ERROR-MSG), the full session state (CARDDEMO-COMMAREA combined with WS-THIS-PROGCOMMAREA) is saved into the communication area (WS-COMMAREA), the program state is set to re-entry mode (CDEMO-PGM-REENTER) so the next user submission is processed as a re-entry, and control is returned to CICS under the current transaction ID (LIT-THISTRANID) with the saved communication area, awaiting the user's next action

rules.rule_name: Detect Fresh Session on Screen Entry
rules.rule_description: Determines whether the user is entering the Credit Card Detail Search screen for the first time with no prior session data, or navigating from the main menu without a re-entry flag, so that the screen is initialized fresh without any residual data.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Is this a fresh session? EIBCALEN = 0

acceptance_criteria.Given: A user navigates to the Credit Card Detail Search screen
acceptance_criteria.When: There is no prior session communication area (session length equals zero) OR the user is arriving from the main menu program without a re-entry flag being set
acceptance_criteria.Then: All session communication areas (CARDDEMO-COMMAREA and WS-THIS-PROGCOMMAREA) are fully initialized to empty/default values, ensuring no residual data from a previous session is carried forward

rules.rule_name: Set Input Prompt on Fresh Session
rules.rule_description: When the screen is entered for the first time with no prior session data, the screen state is set to prompt the user to enter their Account ID and Card Number, as no pre-existing values are available to display.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Set Prompt for Input
Instruct user to enter
Account and Card Number

acceptance_criteria.Given: The Credit Card Detail Search screen is being prepared for display
acceptance_criteria.When: The session communication area length is zero, indicating this is a fresh first-time entry with no prior session
acceptance_criteria.Then: The screen state flag WS-PROMPT-FOR-INPUT is set to TRUE, instructing the screen to display a prompt message asking the user to enter Account ID and Card Number

rules.rule_name: Default to Input Prompt When No Informational Message Exists
rules.rule_description: Even when a session exists, if there is no informational message to display to the user, the screen defaults to prompting the user to enter their Account ID and Card Number, ensuring the user always has clear guidance on what action to take.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Default Prompt Message
Set screen prompt to
enter Account and Card Number

acceptance_criteria.Given: The Credit Card Detail Search screen is being prepared for display and a prior session exists
acceptance_criteria.When: There is no informational message present (WS-NO-INFO-MESSAGE condition is true)
acceptance_criteria.Then: The screen state flag WS-PROMPT-FOR-INPUT is set to TRUE, overriding any other state and instructing the screen to display the standard input prompt asking the user to enter Account ID and Card Number

rules.rule_name: Display Empty Account ID Field on Fresh Session
rules.rule_description: On a fresh session entry, the Account ID field on the Credit Card Detail Search screen is displayed as empty with no pre-filled data, requiring the user to manually enter their account number.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Account ID Field
Display empty
no pre-filled data

acceptance_criteria.Given: The Credit Card Detail Search screen is being prepared for display
acceptance_criteria.When: The session communication area length is zero (fresh session), meaning no Account ID has been previously entered or passed
acceptance_criteria.Then: The Account ID display field (ACCTSIDO) is not populated — the ELSE branch for EIBCALEN not equal to zero handles population, so on fresh entry the field remains at its initialized LOW-VALUES state, presenting an empty Account ID field to the user

rules.rule_name: Display Empty Card Number Field on Fresh Session
rules.rule_description: On a fresh session entry, the Card Number field on the Credit Card Detail Search screen is displayed as empty with no pre-filled data, requiring the user to manually enter their card number.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Card Number Field
Display empty
no pre-filled data

acceptance_criteria.Given: The Credit Card Detail Search screen is being prepared for display
acceptance_criteria.When: The session communication area length is zero (fresh session), meaning no Card Number has been previously entered or passed
acceptance_criteria.Then: The Card Number display field (CARDSIDO) is not populated — the ELSE branch for EIBCALEN not equal to zero handles population, so on fresh entry the field remains at its initialized LOW-VALUES state, presenting an empty Card Number field to the user

rules.rule_name: Display Blank Error and Info Message Areas on Fresh Session
rules.rule_description: On a fresh session entry, both the error message area and the informational message area on the Credit Card Detail Search screen are displayed as blank, since no user actions have been taken yet that could generate errors or informational feedback.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Error Message Area
Display blank
no errors yet

acceptance_criteria.Given: The Credit Card Detail Search screen is being prepared for display for the first time
acceptance_criteria.When: The screen variables are being set up and WS-RETURN-MSG and WS-INFO-MSG have been initialized to spaces/empty values as part of the fresh session initialization
acceptance_criteria.Then: The error message display field (ERRMSGO) receives the contents of WS-RETURN-MSG (which is blank/spaces) and the informational message display field (INFOMSGO) receives the contents of WS-INFO-MSG (which is blank/spaces), resulting in both message areas appearing empty on screen

rules.rule_name: Display Info Message Area as Dimmed When No Message Present
rules.rule_description: When there is no informational message to display, the informational message area on the screen is visually dimmed, providing a clean uncluttered appearance. When an informational message is present, it is shown in a neutral (normal) color.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Info Message Area
Display blank
no info yet

acceptance_criteria.Given: The Credit Card Detail Search screen attributes are being configured for display
acceptance_criteria.When: The WS-NO-INFO-MESSAGE condition is true, indicating no informational message is available to display
acceptance_criteria.Then: The informational message area color attribute (INFOMSGC) is set to DFHBMDAR (dark/dim), making the area visually subdued; conversely, when an informational message IS present, the color attribute is set to DFHNEUTR (neutral/normal) so the message is clearly visible

rules.rule_name: Set Account and Card Number Fields as Editable for Direct Entry
rules.rule_description: When the user arrives at the Credit Card Detail Search screen through direct navigation (not from the Card List screen), both the Account ID and Card Number fields are set as editable, allowing the user to freely type in their search values.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Set Account and Card
Fields as Editable

acceptance_criteria.Given: The Credit Card Detail Search screen attributes are being configured for display
acceptance_criteria.When: The user has NOT arrived from the Card List screen — meaning the last mapset is NOT the Card List mapset (LIT-CCLISTMAPSET) OR the originating program is NOT the Card List program (LIT-CCLISTPGM)
acceptance_criteria.Then: Both the Account ID field attribute (ACCTSIDA) and the Card Number field attribute (CARDSIDA) are set to DFHBMFSE (unprotected/editable), enabling the user to enter or modify values in both fields

rules.rule_name: Position Cursor on Account ID Field by Default
rules.rule_description: When no specific field validation errors are present, the cursor is automatically positioned on the Account ID field as the default starting point, guiding the user to begin data entry at the correct field.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Position Cursor
on Account ID Field
Ready for user input

acceptance_criteria.Given: The Credit Card Detail Search screen attributes are being configured for display
acceptance_criteria.When: None of the specific error conditions are true — the Account ID filter is not flagged as invalid (FLG-ACCTFILTER-NOT-OK is false), the Account ID filter is not blank (FLG-ACCTFILTER-BLANK is false), the Card Number filter is not flagged as invalid (FLG-CARDFILTER-NOT-OK is false), and the Card Number filter is not blank (FLG-CARDFILTER-BLANK is false)
acceptance_criteria.Then: The cursor length indicator for the Account ID field (ACCTSIDL) is set to -1, which positions the screen cursor on the Account ID input field, ready for the user to begin typing their account number

rules.rule_name: Display Credit Card Detail Search Screen to User
rules.rule_description: After all screen fields, attributes, and cursor positioning have been configured, the fully prepared Credit Card Detail Search screen is sent to the user's terminal, and the program state is updated to re-entry mode to correctly handle the user's next interaction.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Display Credit Card
Detail Search Screen
Awaiting user input

acceptance_criteria.Given: All screen fields, display attributes, and cursor position have been fully configured for the Credit Card Detail Search screen
acceptance_criteria.When: The screen send operation is triggered as the final step of the screen preparation process
acceptance_criteria.Then: The program state is set to re-entry mode (CDEMO-PGM-REENTER = TRUE) to correctly handle the user's next submission; the Credit Card Detail Search screen (identified by CCARD-NEXT-MAP and CCARD-NEXT-MAPSET set to LIT-THISMAP and LIT-THISMAPSET respectively) is transmitted to the user's terminal with the cursor positioned as configured, the screen is fully erased and redrawn (ERASE), and the keyboard is unlocked (FREEKB) so the user can begin entering Account ID and Card Number

rules.rule_name: Receive User Input from Screen
rules.rule_description: When the user has re-entered the card detail screen after providing input, the system must capture all data entered by the user from the screen before any processing or validation can occur.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Receive Data Entered by User from Screen

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user has re-entered the card detail screen (program re-entry state is active) and has entered data into the screen fields
acceptance_criteria.When: The system processes the user's screen submission
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system receives and captures all data entered by the user from the card detail screen into the working input area, making it available for subsequent validation and processing

rules.rule_name: Normalize Account Number Input - Replace Wildcard and Spaces
rules.rule_description: Before validating the account number, the system must normalize the entered value by treating an asterisk ('*') or spaces as equivalent to a blank/missing entry, ensuring consistent handling of empty or wildcard inputs.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Normalize Input Fields - Replace asterisk or spaces in Account and Card Number fields with blank indicator

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user has submitted the card detail screen with an Account Number field value
acceptance_criteria.When: The Account Number field contains an asterisk ('*') or spaces
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system replaces the Account Number value with a blank indicator (LOW-VALUES), treating it as if no account number was provided, before proceeding to account validation

rules.rule_name: Normalize Card Number Input - Replace Wildcard and Spaces
rules.rule_description: Before validating the card number, the system must normalize the entered value by treating an asterisk ('*') or spaces as equivalent to a blank/missing entry, ensuring consistent handling of empty or wildcard inputs.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Normalize Input Fields - Replace asterisk or spaces in Account and Card Number fields with blank indicator

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user has submitted the card detail screen with a Card Number field value
acceptance_criteria.When: The Card Number field contains an asterisk ('*') or spaces
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system replaces the Card Number value with a blank indicator (LOW-VALUES), treating it as if no card number was provided, before proceeding to card validation

rules.rule_name: Validate Account Number is Provided
rules.rule_description: The system must verify that the user has provided an Account Number before attempting any further validation or card data retrieval. A blank, spaces-only, or zero-value account number is considered not provided.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Account Number Provided?

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user has submitted the card detail screen and the Account Number field has been normalized
acceptance_criteria.When: The Account Number field is empty (LOW-VALUES), contains only spaces, or has a numeric value of zero
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system sets an input error flag, flags the account filter as blank, clears the session Account ID to zero, and sets a prompt message asking the user to enter an Account Number; validation continues to the Card Number check

rules.rule_name: Validate Account Number is Numeric
rules.rule_description: When an Account Number has been provided, the system must verify that it contains only numeric digits. Non-numeric characters are not acceptable for an account number.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Account Number Is Numeric?

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user has submitted the card detail screen with a non-blank Account Number
acceptance_criteria.When: The Account Number contains non-numeric characters
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system sets an input error flag, flags the account filter as invalid (not-ok), clears the session Account ID to zero, and displays the error message: 'ACCOUNT FILTER,IF SUPPLIED MUST BE A 11 DIGIT NUMBER'; validation continues to the Card Number check

rules.rule_name: Accept Valid Account Number and Store for Retrieval
rules.rule_description: When the Account Number passes all validation checks (provided and numeric), the system accepts it as valid and stores it in the session for use in card data retrieval.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Account Number Valid - Store account number for retrieval

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user has submitted the card detail screen with a non-blank Account Number
acceptance_criteria.When: The Account Number is numeric (passes numeric validation)
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system flags the account filter as valid, copies the entered Account Number into the session Account ID (CDEMO-ACCT-ID) for use in subsequent card data retrieval, and proceeds to Card Number validation

rules.rule_name: Validate Card Number is Provided
rules.rule_description: The system must verify that the user has provided a Card Number before attempting any further validation or card data retrieval. A blank, spaces-only, or zero-value card number is considered not provided.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Card Number Provided?

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user has submitted the card detail screen and the Card Number field has been normalized
acceptance_criteria.When: The Card Number field is empty (LOW-VALUES), contains only spaces, or has a numeric value of zero
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system sets an input error flag, flags the card filter as blank, clears the session Card Number to zero, and sets a prompt message asking the user to enter a Card Number; validation continues to the both-blank check

rules.rule_name: Validate Card Number is Numeric
rules.rule_description: When a Card Number has been provided, the system must verify that it contains only numeric digits. Non-numeric characters are not acceptable for a card number.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Card Number Is Numeric?

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user has submitted the card detail screen with a non-blank Card Number
acceptance_criteria.When: The Card Number contains non-numeric characters
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system sets an input error flag, flags the card filter as invalid (not-ok), clears the session Card Number to zero, and displays the error message: 'CARD ID FILTER,IF SUPPLIED MUST BE A 16 DIGIT NUMBER'; validation continues to the both-blank check

rules.rule_name: Accept Valid Card Number and Store for Retrieval
rules.rule_description: When the Card Number passes all validation checks (provided and numeric), the system accepts it as valid and stores it in the session for use in card data retrieval.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Card Number Valid - Store card number for retrieval

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user has submitted the card detail screen with a non-blank Card Number
acceptance_criteria.When: The Card Number is numeric (passes numeric validation)
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system flags the card filter as valid, copies the entered Card Number into the session Card Number (CDEMO-CARD-NUM) for use in subsequent card data retrieval, and proceeds to the both-blank check

rules.rule_name: Enforce Minimum Search Criteria - Both Fields Cannot Be Blank
rules.rule_description: The system requires at least one search criterion to perform a card lookup. If both the Account Number and Card Number are blank after normalization, the system must flag this as an insufficient search criteria error.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Both Account AND Card Number Blank?

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user has submitted the card detail screen and both Account Number and Card Number fields have been individually validated
acceptance_criteria.When: Both the Account Number filter flag is blank AND the Card Number filter flag is blank simultaneously
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system sets the 'No Search Criteria Received' error condition, indicating that the user must provide at least one valid search value to proceed

rules.rule_name: Route Processing Based on Input Validation Outcome
rules.rule_description: After completing all input validations, the system must determine the next course of action: if any validation errors were found, the screen is re-displayed with error indicators; if all inputs are valid, the system proceeds to retrieve card data.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Any Input Errors Found?

acceptance_criteria.Given: The system has completed validation of both the Account Number and Card Number inputs
acceptance_criteria.When: The input validation process is complete
acceptance_criteria.Then: If any input errors exist (INPUT-ERROR flag is set), the system re-displays the card detail screen with all applicable error messages and field highlights to guide the user in correcting their input; if no input errors exist, the system proceeds to retrieve card data from the card file using the validated Account Number and Card Number

rules.rule_description: When a user enters an asterisk ('*') or leaves the Account Number field blank (spaces) on the Card Detail screen, the system treats the field as if no account number was provided by setting it to a blank indicator value. acceptance_criteria.Then: The Account Number is set to a blank indicator (LOW-VALUES), signaling that no account number was provided; if the Account Number field contains any other value, the entered Account Number is retained as-is for further validation processing

rules.rule_name: Normalize Card Number Input - Replace Asterisk or Spaces with Blank Indicator

If a value other than asterisk or spaces is entered, the system retains the entered Card Number for subsequent validation.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Card Number field contains asterisk or spaces?

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user has submitted the Card Detail screen with a Card Number field value
acceptance_criteria.When: The Card Number field contains an asterisk ('*') OR contains only spaces (i.e., no meaningful value was entered)
acceptance_criteria.Then: The Card Number is set to a blank indicator (LOW-VALUES), signaling that no card number was provided; if the Card Number field contains any other value, the entered Card Number is retained as-is for further validation processing

rules.rule_name: Default Account Filter Status Set to Invalid Before Validation
rules.rule_description: Before any account number validation begins, the account filter status is always preset to Invalid as a safety default, ensuring that only explicitly validated accounts are marked as valid.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Preset account filter status as Invalid

acceptance_criteria.Given: The account number validation process is about to begin for any user-entered Account Number
acceptance_criteria.When: The account validation routine is invoked
acceptance_criteria.Then: The account filter status flag must be immediately set to 'Not OK / Invalid' as the default state, before any value checks are performed

rules.rule_name: Account Number Blank or Zero Triggers Input Error and Blank Flag
rules.rule_description: When the Account Number field is submitted without a value (blank, spaces, or zero), the system must flag the overall input as erroneous and specifically mark the account filter as blank, preventing any card data lookup from proceeding.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Is Account Number blank or zero? → Set Input Error Flag, Set Account Filter as Blank

acceptance_criteria.Given: A user has submitted the card detail screen with the Account Number field
acceptance_criteria.When: The Account Number field contains blank spaces, low-values (empty), or a numeric value of zero
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system must set the overall Input Error flag to TRUE and set the Account Filter status to 'Blank', indicating that a required account value was not provided

rules.rule_name: Prompt Message Displayed When Account Number Is Blank and No Prior Error Message Exists
rules.rule_description: When the Account Number is blank or zero and no other error message has already been set for the screen, the system displays a prompt message instructing the user to provide an Account Number. If a prior error message already exists, the existing message is preserved and no new prompt is set.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Is any error message already set? → Set prompt message: Please provide Account Number

acceptance_criteria.Given: The Account Number field has been determined to be blank or zero, triggering an input error
acceptance_criteria.When: The system checks whether an error or return message has already been set for the current screen interaction
acceptance_criteria.Then: If no prior message is set, the system must set a prompt message instructing the user to provide an Account Number; if a message is already set, the existing message is retained and no new prompt message is applied

rules.rule_name: Account ID Cleared in Session When Account Number Is Blank
rules.rule_description: When the Account Number is determined to be blank or zero, the Account ID stored in the active session context must be reset to zero, ensuring no stale or invalid account value persists in the session for subsequent processing.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Clear Account ID in session context (blank case)

acceptance_criteria.Given: The Account Number field has been determined to be blank or zero
acceptance_criteria.When: The blank account validation path completes its error flagging and message setting
acceptance_criteria.Then: The Account ID value held in the session context (CDEMO-ACCT-ID) must be set to zero, and account validation must exit immediately without further checks

rules.rule_name: Non-Numeric Account Number Triggers Input Error and Invalid Flag
rules.rule_description: When the Account Number field contains a non-blank, non-zero value that is not entirely numeric, the system must flag the overall input as erroneous and mark the account filter status as Invalid, preventing any card data lookup from proceeding.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Is Account Number Numeric? → Set Input Error Flag, Set Account Filter as Invalid

acceptance_criteria.Given: A user has submitted the card detail screen with a non-blank, non-zero value in the Account Number field
acceptance_criteria.When: The Account Number value is found to contain non-numeric characters (i.e., it is not a purely numeric value)
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system must set the overall Input Error flag to TRUE and set the Account Filter status to 'Not OK / Invalid', indicating the account value fails the numeric format requirement

rules.rule_name: Specific Error Message Displayed When Account Number Is Non-Numeric and No Prior Message Exists
rules.rule_description: When the Account Number contains non-numeric characters and no other error message has already been set, the system displays a specific error message informing the user that the Account Number must be an 11-digit numeric value. If a prior error message already exists, it is preserved.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Is any error message already set? → Set Error Message: 'ACCOUNT FILTER, IF SUPPLIED MUST BE A 11 DIGIT NUMBER'

acceptance_criteria.Given: The Account Number field has been determined to contain non-numeric characters, triggering an input error
acceptance_criteria.When: The system checks whether an error or return message has already been set for the current screen interaction
acceptance_criteria.Then: If no prior message is set, the system must display the error message: 'ACCOUNT FILTER, IF SUPPLIED MUST BE A 11 DIGIT NUMBER'; if a message is already set, the existing message is retained and no new error message is applied

rules.rule_name: Account ID Cleared in Session When Account Number Is Non-Numeric
rules.rule_description: When the Account Number is determined to be non-numeric, the Account ID stored in the active session context must be reset to zero, ensuring no invalid account value persists in the session for subsequent processing.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Clear Account ID in session context (non-numeric case)

acceptance_criteria.Given: The Account Number field has been determined to contain non-numeric characters
acceptance_criteria.When: The non-numeric account validation path completes its error flagging and message setting
acceptance_criteria.Then: The Account ID value held in the session context (CDEMO-ACCT-ID) must be set to zero, and account validation must exit immediately without further checks

rules.rule_name: Valid Numeric Account Number Stored in Session and Marked as Valid
rules.rule_description: When the Account Number passes all validation checks (non-blank, non-zero, and fully numeric), it is accepted as valid, stored in the session context for use in card data retrieval, and the account filter status is marked as Valid.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Store valid Account Number in session context → Set Account Filter as Valid

acceptance_criteria.Given: A user has submitted the card detail screen with a non-blank, non-zero Account Number
acceptance_criteria.When: The Account Number value is confirmed to be entirely numeric, passing all validation checks
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system must store the validated Account Number into the session context (CDEMO-ACCT-ID) and set the Account Filter status to 'Valid / Is Valid', allowing the card data lookup to proceed with this account value

rules.rule_name: Initialize Card Filter Validation Status
rules.rule_description: Before any card number validation begins, the card filter status is pre-set to invalid to ensure that only explicitly validated card numbers are accepted as valid.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Set Card Filter Status to Invalid initially

acceptance_criteria.Given: The card number validation process is about to begin for a user-entered Card Number
acceptance_criteria.When: The card number validation routine is invoked
acceptance_criteria.Then: The Card Filter status is set to 'Invalid' as the default starting state, ensuring no card number is assumed valid before validation is performed

rules.rule_name: Detect Blank or Zero Card Number and Flag as Error
rules.rule_description: When a user submits the card detail screen without providing a Card Number, or provides a value that is effectively empty (spaces, low-values, or zero), the system must detect this condition and flag it as an input error with a specific 'blank' indicator.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Is Card Number blank or zero?

acceptance_criteria.Given: A user has submitted the card detail screen with the Card Number field
acceptance_criteria.When: The Card Number field contains blank spaces, low-values (empty), or a numeric value of zero
acceptance_criteria.Then: The overall input status is marked as 'Error', and the Card Filter status is specifically flagged as 'Blank' to distinguish this condition from an invalid format error

rules.rule_name: Display Prompt Message When Card Number is Missing
rules.rule_description: When the Card Number is found to be blank or zero, and no prior error message has already been set for the screen, the system should prompt the user to provide a Card Number. If another error message is already displayed, the existing message takes priority and is not overwritten.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Is an error message already set? / Set Prompt Message: Please provide Card Number

acceptance_criteria.Given: The Card Number field has been determined to be blank or zero, triggering an input error
acceptance_criteria.When: No other error or return message has already been set for the current screen interaction
acceptance_criteria.Then: A prompt message is set instructing the user to provide a Card Number; if an error message was already set from a prior validation step, the existing message is preserved and no new prompt is generated

rules.rule_name: Clear Card Number from Session When Blank
rules.rule_description: When the Card Number is blank or zero, any previously stored Card Number value in the session context must be cleared to zero to prevent stale data from being used in subsequent processing.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Clear Card Number in session context

acceptance_criteria.Given: The Card Number field has been determined to be blank or zero
acceptance_criteria.When: The blank card number condition is confirmed
acceptance_criteria.Then: The Card Number stored in the session context (CDEMO-CARD-NUM) is set to zero, and card number validation ends immediately without further checks

rules.rule_name: Detect Non-Numeric Card Number and Flag as Invalid
rules.rule_description: When a user provides a Card Number that contains non-numeric characters, the system must detect this as an invalid format and flag both the overall input and the card filter as erroneous.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Is Card Number non-numeric?

acceptance_criteria.Given: The Card Number field has been provided with a non-blank, non-zero value
acceptance_criteria.When: The entered Card Number contains one or more non-numeric characters
acceptance_criteria.Then: The overall input status is marked as 'Error', and the Card Filter status is flagged as 'Invalid' (distinct from blank) to indicate a format violation

rules.rule_name: Display 16-Digit Numeric Error Message for Invalid Card Number
rules.rule_description: When the Card Number is found to contain non-numeric characters, and no prior error message has already been set, the system must display a specific error message informing the user that the Card ID must be a 16-digit number. If another error message is already active, it is preserved.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Is an error message already set? / Set Error Message: Card ID Filter must be a 16 digit number

acceptance_criteria.Given: The Card Number field has been determined to contain non-numeric characters, triggering an input error
acceptance_criteria.When: No other error or return message has already been set for the current screen interaction
acceptance_criteria.Then: The error message 'CARD ID FILTER,IF SUPPLIED MUST BE A 16 DIGIT NUMBER' is set for display on the screen; if an error message was already set from a prior validation step, the existing message is preserved and the new message is not generated

rules.rule_name: Clear Card Number from Session When Non-Numeric
rules.rule_description: When the Card Number is found to be non-numeric, any previously stored Card Number value in the session context must be cleared to zero to prevent invalid data from being used in card lookup processing.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Clear Card Number in session context

acceptance_criteria.Given: The Card Number field has been determined to contain non-numeric characters
acceptance_criteria.When: The non-numeric card number condition is confirmed
acceptance_criteria.Then: The Card Number stored in the session context (CDEMO-CARD-NUM) is set to zero, and card number validation ends immediately without further checks

rules.rule_name: Store Valid Card Number in Session Context
rules.rule_description: When the Card Number passes all validation checks (non-blank and fully numeric), the validated numeric card number value must be stored in the session context so it can be used for card record lookup.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Store Valid Card Number in session context

acceptance_criteria.Given: The Card Number field has been provided with a value that is non-blank, non-zero, and fully numeric
acceptance_criteria.When: The Card Number successfully passes both the blank/zero check and the numeric format check
acceptance_criteria.Then: The numeric Card Number value is stored in the session context (CDEMO-CARD-NUM) for use in subsequent card data retrieval

rules.rule_name: Flag Card Filter as Valid After Successful Validation
rules.rule_description: After a Card Number successfully passes all validation checks, the Card Filter status must be explicitly set to 'Valid' to signal downstream processing that the card number is acceptable for use in a card record lookup.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Flag Card Filter as Valid

acceptance_criteria.Given: The Card Number has been confirmed as non-blank, non-zero, and fully numeric
acceptance_criteria.When: All card number validation checks have passed successfully
acceptance_criteria.Then: The Card Filter status is set to 'Valid', overriding the initial 'Invalid' default, and indicating that the card number is ready for use in card data retrieval
