all_rules.Rule_Description: As the final step of PF3 exit navigation, the system transfers control directly to the resolved destination program, passing the complete updated navigation context (communication area). This terminates the current screen session and hands off execution to the destination program with all navigation state preserved.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user has arrived at the Card Detail screen by navigating from the Credit Card List screen (CDEMO-FROM-PROGRAM equals the Card List program identifier) and the program is in first-entry mode (CDEMO-PGM-ENTER is TRUE)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The program initializes the card detail screen for display
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The Account ID (CC-ACCT-ID-N) is populated from the session-stored Account ID (CDEMO-ACCT-ID) and the Card Number (CC-CARD-NUM-N) is populated from the session-stored Card Number (CDEMO-CARD-NUM), carrying forward the values selected on the Card List screen

all_rules.Rule_Name: Accept Pre-Validated Account and Card Number from Card List Screen
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the user navigates to the Card Detail screen directly from the Credit Card List screen, the Account ID and Card Number previously selected on the list screen are automatically carried over into the current screen context without requiring the user to re-enter them.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user has arrived at the Card Detail screen from the Credit Card List screen and the Account ID and Card Number have been accepted from the prior screen context
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The program prepares to retrieve card data
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The input status is immediately set to INPUT-OK (valid), bypassing all account and card number format and content validation checks that would otherwise be applied to user-entered data

all_rules.Rule_Name: Bypass Input Re-Validation for Card List Originated Entry
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the Account ID and Card Number are received from the Credit Card List screen, they are treated as already validated and accepted without subjecting them to the standard input validation checks applied to manually entered values.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The Card Number (CC-CARD-NUM) has been accepted from the Card List screen context and input status is marked as valid
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system performs a card data lookup
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The Card Number is used as the unique record identifier (WS-CARD-RID-CARDNUM) to read the card record from the Card Data File (CARDDAT), retrieving the full card record (CARD-RECORD) including all card details

all_rules.Rule_Name: Retrieve Card Record Using Card Number as Lookup Key
all_rules.Rule_Description: The system retrieves the full card record from the Card Data File by using the Card Number as the unique lookup key to obtain all card details associated with that card.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A card lookup has been performed using the Card Number as the key against the Card Data File
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The Card Data File returns a successful response indicating the card record was found
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system sets the FOUND-CARDS-FOR-ACCOUNT status to TRUE, indicating that valid card details are available and ready to be displayed on the screen

all_rules.Rule_Name: Mark Card as Found When Record Successfully Retrieved
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the card record is successfully located in the Card Data File using the provided Card Number, the system marks the retrieval as successful, enabling the card details to be prepared and presented to the user.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A card lookup has been performed using the Card Number as the key against the Card Data File
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The Card Data File returns a 'not found' response indicating no matching card record exists for the provided Card Number
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system sets INPUT-ERROR to TRUE, sets FLG-ACCTFILTER-NOT-OK to TRUE for the Account ID field, sets FLG-CARDFILTER-NOT-OK to TRUE for the Card Number field, and — if no prior error message has been set — activates the DID-NOT-FIND-ACCTCARD-COMBO message flag to inform the user that the account and card combination does not exist

all_rules.Rule_Name: Set Error Flags for Both Fields When Card and Account Combination Not Found
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the Card Data File does not contain a record matching the provided Card Number, the system flags both the Account ID and Card Number fields as invalid and prepares a user-facing message indicating the account and card combination could not be found.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The card lookup has returned a successful result and FOUND-CARDS-FOR-ACCOUNT is TRUE
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system prepares the card detail screen for display
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The screen is populated with the following card details from the retrieved card record: Card Embossed Name (CARD-EMBOSSED-NAME) displayed in the cardholder name field (CRDNAMEO), Card Expiry Month (CARD-EXPIRY-MONTH) displayed in the expiry month field (EXPMONO), Card Expiry Year (CARD-EXPIRY-YEAR) displayed in the expiry year field (EXPYEARO), and Card Active Status (CARD-ACTIVE-STATUS) displayed in the card status field (CRDSTCDO)

all_rules.Rule_Name: Display Card Holder Details When Card Record is Found
all_rules.Rule_Description: When a card record is successfully retrieved, the system populates the screen with the full set of card holder details including the name embossed on the card, the card's expiration date components, and the current active status of the card.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The card lookup has returned a 'not found' result, INPUT-ERROR is TRUE, FLG-ACCTFILTER-NOT-OK is TRUE, and FLG-CARDFILTER-NOT-OK is TRUE
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system prepares the screen attributes for display
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The Account ID field (ACCTSIDC in CCRDSLAO) is set to RED color (DFHRED) and the Card Number field (CARDSIDC in CCRDSLAO) is set to RED color (DFHRED), visually indicating to the user that both fields are in error, and the error message describing the not-found condition is displayed in the screen error message area (ERRMSGO)

all_rules.Rule_Name: Highlight Account and Card Fields in Red When Card Combination Not Found
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the account and card combination is not found, the system visually highlights both the Account ID and Card Number fields in red on the screen to clearly direct the user's attention to the fields that contain the unresolvable values.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The card detail screen has been fully prepared and sent to the user terminal, either with card details displayed or with error messages and highlighted fields
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The screen send operation completes
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The current error or return message is moved to the screen error message field (CCARD-ERROR-MSG), the full session state (CARDDEMO-COMMAREA combined with WS-THIS-PROGCOMMAREA) is saved into the communication area (WS-COMMAREA), the program state is set to re-entry mode (CDEMO-PGM-REENTER) so the next user submission is processed as a re-entry, and control is returned to CICS under the current transaction ID (LIT-THISTRANID) with the saved communication area, awaiting the user's next action

all_rules.Rule_Name: Return Control to Await Next User Action After Card Detail Display
all_rules.Rule_Description: After the card detail screen has been sent to the user — whether showing successful card details or an error condition — the system saves the current session state and returns control to CICS, waiting for the user's next interaction with the screen.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A user navigates to the Credit Card Detail Search screen
Acceptance_Criteria.When: There is no prior session communication area (session length equals zero) OR the user is arriving from the main menu program without a re-entry flag being set
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: All session communication areas (CARDDEMO-COMMAREA and WS-THIS-PROGCOMMAREA) are fully initialized to empty/default values, ensuring no residual data from a previous session is carried forward

all_rules.Rule_Name: Detect Fresh Session on Screen Entry
all_rules.Rule_Description: Determines whether the user is entering the Credit Card Detail Search screen for the first time with no prior session data, or navigating from the main menu without a re-entry flag, so that the screen is initialized fresh without any residual data.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The Credit Card Detail Search screen is being prepared for display
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The session communication area length is zero, indicating this is a fresh first-time entry with no prior session
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The screen state flag WS-PROMPT-FOR-INPUT is set to TRUE, instructing the screen to display a prompt message asking the user to enter Account ID and Card Number

all_rules.Rule_Name: Set Input Prompt on Fresh Session
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the screen is entered for the first time with no prior session data, the screen state is set to prompt the user to enter their Account ID and Card Number, as no pre-existing values are available to display.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The Credit Card Detail Search screen is being prepared for display and a prior session exists
Acceptance_Criteria.When: There is no informational message present (WS-NO-INFO-MESSAGE condition is true)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The screen state flag WS-PROMPT-FOR-INPUT is set to TRUE, overriding any other state and instructing the screen to display the standard input prompt asking the user to enter Account ID and Card Number

all_rules.Rule_Name: Default to Input Prompt When No Informational Message Exists
all_rules.Rule_Description: Even when a session exists, if there is no informational message to display to the user, the screen defaults to prompting the user to enter their Account ID and Card Number, ensuring the user always has clear guidance on what action to take.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The Credit Card Detail Search screen is being prepared for display
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The session communication area length is zero (fresh session), meaning no Account ID has been previously entered or passed
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The Account ID display field (ACCTSIDO) is not populated — the ELSE branch for EIBCALEN not equal to zero handles population, so on fresh entry the field remains at its initialized LOW-VALUES state, presenting an empty Account ID field to the user

all_rules.Rule_Name: Display Empty Account ID Field on Fresh Session
all_rules.Rule_Description: On a fresh session entry, the Account ID field on the Credit Card Detail Search screen is displayed as empty with no pre-filled data, requiring the user to manually enter their account number.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The Credit Card Detail Search screen is being prepared for display
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The session communication area length is zero (fresh session), meaning no Card Number has been previously entered or passed
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The Card Number display field (CARDSIDO) is not populated — the ELSE branch for EIBCALEN not equal to zero handles population, so on fresh entry the field remains at its initialized LOW-VALUES state, presenting an empty Card Number field to the user

all_rules.Rule_Name: Display Empty Card Number Field on Fresh Session
all_rules.Rule_Description: On a fresh session entry, the Card Number field on the Credit Card Detail Search screen is displayed as empty with no pre-filled data, requiring the user to manually enter their card number.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The Credit Card Detail Search screen is being prepared for display for the first time
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The screen variables are being set up and WS-RETURN-MSG and WS-INFO-MSG have been initialized to spaces/empty values as part of the fresh session initialization
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The error message display field (ERRMSGO) receives the contents of WS-RETURN-MSG (which is blank/spaces) and the informational message display field (INFOMSGO) receives the contents of WS-INFO-MSG (which is blank/spaces), resulting in both message areas appearing empty on screen

all_rules.Rule_Name: Display Blank Error and Info Message Areas on Fresh Session
all_rules.Rule_Description: On a fresh session entry, both the error message area and the informational message area on the Credit Card Detail Search screen are displayed as blank, since no user actions have been taken yet that could generate errors or informational feedback.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The Credit Card Detail Search screen attributes are being configured for display
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The WS-NO-INFO-MESSAGE condition is true, indicating no informational message is available to display
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The informational message area color attribute (INFOMSGC) is set to DFHBMDAR (dark/dim), making the area visually subdued; conversely, when an informational message IS present, the color attribute is set to DFHNEUTR (neutral/normal) so the message is clearly visible

all_rules.Rule_Name: Display Info Message Area as Dimmed When No Message Present
all_rules.Rule_Description: When there is no informational message to display, the informational message area on the screen is visually dimmed, providing a clean uncluttered appearance. When an informational message is present, it is shown in a neutral (normal) color.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The Credit Card Detail Search screen attributes are being configured for display
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The user has NOT arrived from the Card List screen — meaning the last mapset is NOT the Card List mapset (LIT-CCLISTMAPSET) OR the originating program is NOT the Card List program (LIT-CCLISTPGM)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: Both the Account ID field attribute (ACCTSIDA) and the Card Number field attribute (CARDSIDA) are set to DFHBMFSE (unprotected/editable), enabling the user to enter or modify values in both fields

all_rules.Rule_Name: Set Account and Card Number Fields as Editable for Direct Entry
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the user arrives at the Credit Card Detail Search screen through direct navigation (not from the Card List screen), both the Account ID and Card Number fields are set as editable, allowing the user to freely type in their search values.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The Credit Card Detail Search screen attributes are being configured for display
Acceptance_Criteria.When: None of the specific error conditions are true — the Account ID filter is not flagged as invalid (FLG-ACCTFILTER-NOT-OK is false), the Account ID filter is not blank (FLG-ACCTFILTER-BLANK is false), the Card Number filter is not flagged as invalid (FLG-CARDFILTER-NOT-OK is false), and the Card Number filter is not blank (FLG-CARDFILTER-BLANK is false)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The cursor length indicator for the Account ID field (ACCTSIDL) is set to -1, which positions the screen cursor on the Account ID input field, ready for the user to begin typing their account number

all_rules.Rule_Name: Position Cursor on Account ID Field by Default
all_rules.Rule_Description: When no specific field validation errors are present, the cursor is automatically positioned on the Account ID field as the default starting point, guiding the user to begin data entry at the correct field.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: All screen fields, display attributes, and cursor position have been fully configured for the Credit Card Detail Search screen
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The screen send operation is triggered as the final step of the screen preparation process
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The program state is set to re-entry mode (CDEMO-PGM-REENTER = TRUE) to correctly handle the user's next submission; the Credit Card Detail Search screen (identified by CCARD-NEXT-MAP and CCARD-NEXT-MAPSET set to LIT-THISMAP and LIT-THISMAPSET respectively) is transmitted to the user's terminal with the cursor positioned as configured, the screen is fully erased and redrawn (ERASE), and the keyboard is unlocked (FREEKB) so the user can begin entering Account ID and Card Number

all_rules.Rule_Name: Display Credit Card Detail Search Screen to User
all_rules.Rule_Description: After all screen fields, attributes, and cursor positioning have been configured, the fully prepared Credit Card Detail Search screen is sent to the user's terminal, and the program state is updated to re-entry mode to correctly handle the user's next interaction.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user has re-entered the card detail screen (program re-entry state is active) and has entered data into the screen fields
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system processes the user's screen submission
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system receives and captures all data entered by the user from the card detail screen into the working input area, making it available for subsequent validation and processing

all_rules.Rule_Name: Receive User Input from Screen
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the user has re-entered the card detail screen after providing input, the system must capture all data entered by the user from the screen before any processing or validation can occur.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user has submitted the card detail screen with an Account Number field value
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The Account Number field contains an asterisk ('*') or spaces
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system replaces the Account Number value with a blank indicator (LOW-VALUES), treating it as if no account number was provided, before proceeding to account validation

all_rules.Rule_Name: Normalize Account Number Input - Replace Wildcard and Spaces
all_rules.Rule_Description: Before validating the account number, the system must normalize the entered value by treating an asterisk ('*') or spaces as equivalent to a blank/missing entry, ensuring consistent handling of empty or wildcard inputs.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user has submitted the card detail screen with a Card Number field value
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The Card Number field contains an asterisk ('*') or spaces
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system replaces the Card Number value with a blank indicator (LOW-VALUES), treating it as if no card number was provided, before proceeding to card validation

all_rules.Rule_Name: Normalize Card Number Input - Replace Wildcard and Spaces
all_rules.Rule_Description: Before validating the card number, the system must normalize the entered value by treating an asterisk ('*') or spaces as equivalent to a blank/missing entry, ensuring consistent handling of empty or wildcard inputs.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user has submitted the card detail screen and the Account Number field has been normalized
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The Account Number field is empty (LOW-VALUES), contains only spaces, or has a numeric value of zero
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system sets an input error flag, flags the account filter as blank, clears the session Account ID to zero, and sets a prompt message asking the user to enter an Account Number; validation continues to the Card Number check

all_rules.Rule_Name: Validate Account Number is Provided
all_rules.Rule_Description: The system must verify that the user has provided an Account Number before attempting any further validation or card data retrieval. A blank, spaces-only, or zero-value account number is considered not provided.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user has submitted the card detail screen with a non-blank Account Number
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The Account Number contains non-numeric characters
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system sets an input error flag, flags the account filter as invalid (not-ok), clears the session Account ID to zero, and displays the error message: 'ACCOUNT FILTER,IF SUPPLIED MUST BE A 11 DIGIT NUMBER'; validation continues to the Card Number check

all_rules.Rule_Name: Validate Account Number is Numeric
all_rules.Rule_Description: When an Account Number has been provided, the system must verify that it contains only numeric digits. Non-numeric characters are not acceptable for an account number.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user has submitted the card detail screen with a non-blank Account Number
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The Account Number is numeric (passes numeric validation)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system flags the account filter as valid, copies the entered Account Number into the session Account ID (CDEMO-ACCT-ID) for use in subsequent card data retrieval, and proceeds to Card Number validation

all_rules.Rule_Name: Accept Valid Account Number and Store for Retrieval
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the Account Number passes all validation checks (provided and numeric), the system accepts it as valid and stores it in the session for use in card data retrieval.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user has submitted the card detail screen and the Card Number field has been normalized
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The Card Number field is empty (LOW-VALUES), contains only spaces, or has a numeric value of zero
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system sets an input error flag, flags the card filter as blank, clears the session Card Number to zero, and sets a prompt message asking the user to enter a Card Number; validation continues to the both-blank check

all_rules.Rule_Name: Validate Card Number is Provided
all_rules.Rule_Description: The system must verify that the user has provided a Card Number before attempting any further validation or card data retrieval. A blank, spaces-only, or zero-value card number is considered not provided.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user has submitted the card detail screen with a non-blank Card Number
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The Card Number contains non-numeric characters
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system sets an input error flag, flags the card filter as invalid (not-ok), clears the session Card Number to zero, and displays the error message: 'CARD ID FILTER,IF SUPPLIED MUST BE A 16 DIGIT NUMBER'; validation continues to the both-blank check

all_rules.Rule_Name: Validate Card Number is Numeric
all_rules.Rule_Description: When a Card Number has been provided, the system must verify that it contains only numeric digits. Non-numeric characters are not acceptable for a card number.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user has submitted the card detail screen with a non-blank Card Number
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The Card Number is numeric (passes numeric validation)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system flags the card filter as valid, copies the entered Card Number into the session Card Number (CDEMO-CARD-NUM) for use in subsequent card data retrieval, and proceeds to the both-blank check

all_rules.Rule_Name: Accept Valid Card Number and Store for Retrieval
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the Card Number passes all validation checks (provided and numeric), the system accepts it as valid and stores it in the session for use in card data retrieval.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user has submitted the card detail screen and both Account Number and Card Number fields have been individually validated
Acceptance_Criteria.When: Both the Account Number filter flag is blank AND the Card Number filter flag is blank simultaneously
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system sets the 'No Search Criteria Received' error condition, indicating that the user must provide at least one valid search value to proceed

all_rules.Rule_Name: Enforce Minimum Search Criteria - Both Fields Cannot Be Blank
all_rules.Rule_Description: The system requires at least one search criterion to perform a card lookup. If both the Account Number and Card Number are blank after normalization, the system must flag this as an insufficient search criteria error.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The system has completed validation of both the Account Number and Card Number inputs
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The input validation process is complete
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: If any input errors exist (INPUT-ERROR flag is set), the system re-displays the card detail screen with all applicable error messages and field highlights to guide the user in correcting their input; if no input errors exist, the system proceeds to retrieve card data from the card file using the validated Account Number and Card Number

all_rules.Rule_Name: Route Processing Based on Input Validation Outcome
all_rules.Rule_Description: After completing all input validations, the system must determine the next course of action: if any validation errors were found, the screen is re-displayed with error indicators; if all inputs are valid, the system proceeds to retrieve card data.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The screen initialization process has been triggered to prepare the card detail screen for display
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system begins the screen initialization sequence
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: All screen output fields in the card detail screen (CCRDSLAO) are cleared by setting them to low values, ensuring no previously displayed data remains visible on the screen

all_rules.Rule_Name: Clear Screen Output Fields Before Display
all_rules.Rule_Description: Before populating the card detail screen with new data, all screen output fields must be reset to ensure no residual data from a previous display is shown to the user.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The screen initialization process is preparing the card detail screen header
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system needs to populate the date and time fields on the screen header
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system retrieves the current date and time using the system's current-date function and stores it in the working storage date/time data area (WS-CURDATE-DATA) for subsequent formatting and display

all_rules.Rule_Name: Retrieve Current System Date and Time
all_rules.Rule_Description: The system must obtain the current date and time from the system clock to display accurate temporal information on the card detail screen header.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The screen initialization process is setting up the card detail screen header
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system populates the screen header fields
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The first title line on the screen header (TITLE01O) is set to the predefined application title value (CCDA-TITLE01), providing the primary screen identification label to the user

all_rules.Rule_Name: Display Screen Title Line 1 on Header
all_rules.Rule_Description: The first title line of the card detail screen must be populated from the predefined application title definition to provide consistent screen identification to the user.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The screen initialization process is setting up the card detail screen header
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system populates the screen header fields after setting Title Line 1
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The second title line on the screen header (TITLE02O) is set to the predefined application secondary title value (CCDA-TITLE02), providing the secondary screen identification label to the user

all_rules.Rule_Name: Display Screen Title Line 2 on Header
all_rules.Rule_Description: The second title line of the card detail screen must be populated from the predefined application title definition to provide complete screen identification to the user.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The screen initialization process is setting up the card detail screen header
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system populates the transaction identification field on the screen header
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The transaction name field on the screen header (TRNNAMEO) is set to the current transaction ID value (LIT-THISTRANID), allowing the user to identify the active transaction

all_rules.Rule_Name: Display Current Transaction ID on Screen Header
all_rules.Rule_Description: The transaction identifier for the current screen must be displayed in the screen header so the user can identify which transaction they are currently executing.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The screen initialization process is setting up the card detail screen header
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system populates the program identification field on the screen header
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The program name field on the screen header (PGMNAMEO) is set to the current program name value (LIT-THISPGM), allowing the user to identify the active program

all_rules.Rule_Name: Display Current Program Name on Screen Header
all_rules.Rule_Description: The name of the currently executing program must be displayed in the screen header to provide the user with context about which program is handling their request.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The current system date has been retrieved and stored in the working storage date area (WS-CURDATE-DATA)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system formats the date for screen header display
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system extracts the month component into WS-CURDATE-MM, the day component into WS-CURDATE-DD, and the last two digits of the year (characters 3-4 of the year field) into WS-CURDATE-YY, composing the date in MM-DD-YY format stored in WS-CURDATE-MM-DD-YY

all_rules.Rule_Name: Format Current Date as MM-DD-YY for Screen Display
all_rules.Rule_Description: The current system date must be formatted into the standard MM-DD-YY display format by extracting the month, day, and two-digit year components separately before being shown on the screen header.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The current date has been formatted into MM-DD-YY format and stored in WS-CURDATE-MM-DD-YY
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system sets the date field on the screen header
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The formatted date value from WS-CURDATE-MM-DD-YY is moved to the screen header date output field (CURDATEO) of the card detail screen (CCRDSLAO), displaying the current date to the user in MM-DD-YY format

all_rules.Rule_Name: Set Formatted Date on Screen Header
all_rules.Rule_Description: The date formatted in MM-DD-YY format must be placed into the screen header date display field so the user can see the current date while using the card detail screen.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The current system time has been retrieved and stored in the working storage date/time area (WS-CURDATE-DATA)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system formats the time for screen header display
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system extracts the hours component into WS-CURTIME-HH, the minutes component into WS-CURTIME-MM, and the seconds component into WS-CURTIME-SS, composing the time in HH-MM-SS format stored in WS-CURTIME-HH-MM-SS

all_rules.Rule_Name: Format Current Time as HH-MM-SS for Screen Display
all_rules.Rule_Description: The current system time must be formatted into the standard HH-MM-SS display format by extracting the hours, minutes, and seconds components separately before being shown on the screen header.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The current time has been formatted into HH-MM-SS format and stored in WS-CURTIME-HH-MM-SS
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system sets the time field on the screen header
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The formatted time value from WS-CURTIME-HH-MM-SS is moved to the screen header time output field (CURTIMEO) of the card detail screen (CCRDSLAO), displaying the current time to the user in HH-MM-SS format

all_rules.Rule_Name: Set Formatted Time on Screen Header
all_rules.Rule_Description: The time formatted in HH-MM-SS format must be placed into the screen header time display field so the user can see the current time while using the card detail screen.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The card detail screen is being prepared for display AND a prior session communication area exists (session is not a first-time entry)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The Account ID value stored in the session communication area (CDEMO-ACCT-ID) is equal to zero, meaning no valid account number has been recorded in the session
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The Account ID display field (ACCTSIDO) on the card detail screen is populated with a blank/empty value (LOW-VALUES), so the user sees an empty Account ID field

all_rules.Rule_Name: Display Blank Account ID Field When No Account Is Stored
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the screen is being prepared for display and the Account ID stored in the session communication area has a value of zero, the Account ID field on the card detail screen must be shown as blank/empty, indicating that no account number is currently associated with the session.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The card detail screen is being prepared for display AND a prior session communication area exists (session is not a first-time entry)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The Account ID value stored in the session communication area (CDEMO-ACCT-ID) is NOT equal to zero, meaning a valid account number has been recorded in the session
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The Account ID display field (ACCTSIDO) on the card detail screen is populated with the stored Account Number (CC-ACCT-ID), so the user sees the account number that is currently being viewed or searched

all_rules.Rule_Name: Display Stored Account Number in Account ID Field When Account Exists
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the screen is being prepared for display and the Account ID stored in the session communication area contains a non-zero value, the Account ID field on the card detail screen must be populated with the stored account number, allowing the user to see the account number currently being viewed.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The card detail screen is being prepared for display and the system retrieves the stored Card Number value from the active session communication area (CDEMO-CARD-NUM)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system evaluates whether the stored Card Number is equal to zero
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: If the stored Card Number equals zero, the Card Number field on the screen (CARDSIDO) is populated with a blank/empty value (no card number is shown to the user); If the stored Card Number is not zero, the Card Number field on the screen (CARDSIDO) is populated with the actual stored Card Number value (CC-CARD-NUM) retrieved from the session

all_rules.Rule_Name: Card Number Field Display Based on Stored Value
all_rules.Rule_Description: When preparing the card detail screen for display, the Card Number field is conditionally populated based on whether a valid card number exists in the session. If no card number has been established (value is zero), the field is shown as blank. If a card number is present, it is displayed in the Card Number field on screen.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A card detail screen display has been triggered after a card lookup was performed using the Card Number as the search key
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system evaluates whether the card record was successfully retrieved from the card file (FOUND-CARDS-FOR-ACCOUNT flag is TRUE)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: If the card was found, the system proceeds to populate all card detail fields (Card Holder Name, Expiration Month, Expiration Year, Active Status) on the screen; if the card was not found, all card detail fields are left blank on the screen

all_rules.Rule_Name: Determine Card Data Retrieval Success Before Display
all_rules.Rule_Description: Before populating card detail fields on the screen, the system checks whether a card record was successfully found in the card file using the provided Card Number. This decision controls whether card details are shown or left blank.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A card record has been successfully retrieved from the card file and the FOUND-CARDS-FOR-ACCOUNT condition is TRUE
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system prepares the card detail screen for display
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The Card Embossed Name (CARD-EMBOSSED-NAME) from the retrieved card record is moved to the Card Name output field (CRDNAMEO) on the screen display

all_rules.Rule_Name: Populate Card Holder Name on Screen
all_rules.Rule_Description: When a card record has been successfully retrieved, the embossed name associated with the card (the name physically printed on the card) is displayed on the card detail screen.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A card record has been successfully retrieved from the card file and the FOUND-CARDS-FOR-ACCOUNT condition is TRUE
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system prepares the card detail screen for display
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The Card Expiration Date (CARD-EXPIRAION-DATE) is first parsed into its date components (CARD-EXPIRAION-DATE-X), and then the Card Expiry Month (CARD-EXPIRY-MONTH) is moved to the Expiration Month output field (EXPMONO) on the screen display

all_rules.Rule_Name: Populate Card Expiration Month on Screen
all_rules.Rule_Description: When a card record has been successfully retrieved, the card expiration month is extracted from the card expiration date and displayed on the card detail screen.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A card record has been successfully retrieved from the card file and the FOUND-CARDS-FOR-ACCOUNT condition is TRUE, and the card expiration date has been parsed into its components
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system prepares the card detail screen for display
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The Card Expiry Year (CARD-EXPIRY-YEAR) is moved to the Expiration Year output field (EXPYEARO) on the screen display

all_rules.Rule_Name: Populate Card Expiration Year on Screen
all_rules.Rule_Description: When a card record has been successfully retrieved, the card expiration year is displayed on the card detail screen.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A card record has been successfully retrieved from the card file and the FOUND-CARDS-FOR-ACCOUNT condition is TRUE
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system prepares the card detail screen for display
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The Card Active Status (CARD-ACTIVE-STATUS) from the retrieved card record is moved to the Card Status Code output field (CRDSTCDO) on the screen display, indicating whether the card is currently active or inactive

all_rules.Rule_Name: Populate Card Active Status on Screen
all_rules.Rule_Description: When a card record has been successfully retrieved, the current active or inactive status of the card is displayed on the card detail screen.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A card lookup was performed but no matching card record was found in the card file (FOUND-CARDS-FOR-ACCOUNT condition is FALSE), and the screen output area (CCRDSLAO) was initialized to LOW-VALUES at the start of screen preparation
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system prepares the card detail screen for display
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The card detail fields — Card Holder Name (CRDNAMEO), Expiration Month (EXPMONO), Expiration Year (EXPYEARO), and Card Active Status (CRDSTCDO) — are not populated and remain blank on the screen display, as no MOVE operations are performed for these fields

all_rules.Rule_Name: Leave Card Detail Fields Blank When Card Not Found
all_rules.Rule_Description: When no card record was found for the provided Card Number, all card detail fields on the screen are left blank. No card holder name, expiration date, or active status is displayed.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The screen is being prepared for display and no informational message is currently set (WS-NO-INFO-MESSAGE condition is true)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system evaluates whether an informational message exists for display
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The screen prompt is defaulted to instruct the user to enter Account and Card Number (WS-PROMPT-FOR-INPUT is set to TRUE), overriding any absence of guidance message so the user knows what input is required

all_rules.Rule_Name: Default Screen Prompt When No Informational Message Exists
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the screen is being prepared for display and no informational message has been set in the session, the system automatically defaults the screen prompt to instruct the user to enter their Account ID and Card Number as search criteria.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The screen is being prepared for display and an informational message is currently set (WS-NO-INFO-MESSAGE condition is false, meaning WS-INFO-MSG contains a message)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system evaluates whether an informational message exists for display
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The existing informational message (WS-INFO-MSG) is kept as-is and is moved to the informational message display field (INFOMSGO) on the screen without being replaced by the default prompt

all_rules.Rule_Name: Retain Existing Informational Message When Already Set
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the screen is being prepared for display and an informational message has already been set in the session, the system retains and displays that existing informational message without overriding it with the default prompt.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The screen prompt has been defaulted to 'Enter Account and Card Number' because no informational message was set (WS-NO-INFO-MESSAGE is true)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The screen attributes and message fields are being finalized for display
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The prompt message (WS-INFO-MSG containing the default prompt) is moved to the informational message display field (INFOMSGO) on the screen, AND the informational message display area is rendered in a dimmed/dark visual attribute (DFHBMDAR) to distinguish it as a default system prompt

all_rules.Rule_Name: Display Default Prompt Message on Screen
all_rules.Rule_Description: When no informational message is set, the default prompt instructing the user to enter Account and Card Number is displayed in the informational message area on the screen, and the info message display area is visually dimmed to indicate it is a system-generated default prompt rather than an active informational message.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: An informational message is currently set in the session (WS-NO-INFO-MESSAGE is false, meaning WS-INFO-MSG contains content)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The screen attributes and message fields are being finalized for display
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The existing informational message (WS-INFO-MSG) is moved to the informational message display field (INFOMSGO) on the screen, AND the informational message display area is rendered in a neutral visual attribute (DFHNEUTR) to present it as an active informational message to the user

all_rules.Rule_Name: Display Existing Informational Message on Screen
all_rules.Rule_Description: When an informational message has been set in the session, it is displayed in the informational message area on the screen with a neutral visual style, indicating it is an active system-generated informational message for the user.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The screen is being prepared for display for the first time with no existing session data (EIBCALEN equals zero, indicating no prior communication area)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system sets up the screen variables for initial display
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The screen prompt is defaulted to instruct the user to enter Account and Card Number (WS-PROMPT-FOR-INPUT is set to TRUE), so the user is immediately guided to provide the required search criteria

all_rules.Rule_Name: Default Prompt on First-Time Screen Entry
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the screen is displayed for the very first time in a new session (no prior communication area exists), the system automatically sets the default prompt to instruct the user to enter their Account ID and Card Number, ensuring the user is guided on what input is required from the start.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The card detail screen is being prepared for display after any processing step (initial entry, re-entry, data retrieval, or validation), and the error/return message field (WS-RETURN-MSG) either contains a message text (e.g., 'ACCOUNT FILTER, IF SUPPLIED MUST BE A 11 DIGIT NUMBER', 'CARD ID FILTER, IF SUPPLIED MUST BE A 16 DIGIT NUMBER', account/card not found message, or any system prompt) or is empty/blank
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The screen output fields are being populated in preparation for sending the screen to the user terminal
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The current value of the error/return message (WS-RETURN-MSG) is moved directly to the screen error message output field (ERRMSGO): if WS-RETURN-MSG contains a message, that message text is displayed in the error message area of the screen; if WS-RETURN-MSG is blank or spaces, the screen error message field is displayed as blank, providing no error indication to the user

all_rules.Rule_Name: Display Error or Return Message in Screen Error Field
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the card detail screen is being prepared for display, any error or return message that has been set during processing (such as validation failures, record not found, or system prompts) must be shown in the screen's error message field. If no message has been set, the error message field is left blank, providing a clean display to the user.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The card detail screen is being prepared for display after any processing step, and the informational message field (WS-INFO-MSG) either contains an informational text or is empty/blank
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The screen output fields are being populated in preparation for sending the screen to the user terminal
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The current value of the informational message (WS-INFO-MSG) is moved directly to the screen informational message output field (INFOMSGO): if WS-INFO-MSG contains a message, that informational text is displayed in the info message area of the screen; if WS-INFO-MSG is blank or spaces, the screen informational message field is displayed as blank, showing no informational content to the user

all_rules.Rule_Name: Display Informational Message in Screen Info Field
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the card detail screen is being prepared for display, any informational message that has been set during processing must be shown in the screen's informational message field. If no informational message has been set, the info message field is left blank. This field is separate from the error message field and is used to convey non-error guidance or status information to the user.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The card detail screen is being set up for display and the system has a record of the last mapset visited and the originating program name
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system checks whether the last mapset matches the Card List mapset (CCLISTMAPSET) AND the originating program matches the Card List program (CCLISTPGM) — both conditions must be true simultaneously
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: If both conditions are true, the Account ID and Card Number fields are set to protected (read-only) mode; if either or both conditions are false, both fields are set to editable mode allowing user input

all_rules.Rule_Name: Determine Screen Field Editability Based on Navigation Source
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the card detail screen is being prepared for display, the system must determine whether the user navigated from the Card List screen. This decision drives whether the Account ID and Card Number fields are protected (read-only) or editable, ensuring users cannot accidentally alter pre-selected values when arriving from a list selection.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The card detail screen is being prepared for display, and the system confirms that the last mapset visited was the Card List mapset (CCLISTMAPSET) AND the originating program was the Card List program (CCLISTPGM)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: Both the last mapset and the originating program match the Card List screen identifiers
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The Account ID input field (ACCTSIDA) is set to protected/read-only mode so the user cannot modify it, AND the Card Number input field (CARDSIDA) is also set to protected/read-only mode so the user cannot modify it — both fields are locked simultaneously

all_rules.Rule_Name: Protect Account ID and Card Number Fields When Arriving from Card List
all_rules.Rule_Description: When a user arrives at the card detail screen by selecting a record from the Card List screen, the Account ID and Card Number fields must be made read-only to preserve the integrity of the selection made on the list. The user should not be able to alter these pre-populated values.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The card detail screen is being prepared for display, and the navigation source is NOT the Card List screen — meaning either the last mapset does not match the Card List mapset (CCLISTMAPSET), OR the originating program does not match the Card List program (CCLISTPGM), or both conditions are unmet
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system determines the user did not arrive from the Card List screen
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The Account ID input field (ACCTSIDA) is set to editable mode allowing the user to type or modify an account number, AND the Card Number input field (CARDSIDA) is also set to editable mode allowing the user to type or modify a card number — both fields are made available for input simultaneously

all_rules.Rule_Name: Make Account ID and Card Number Fields Editable When Arriving from Any Other Screen
all_rules.Rule_Description: When a user arrives at the card detail screen from any source other than the Card List screen (e.g., direct navigation, main menu, or any other program), both the Account ID and Card Number fields must be made fully editable, allowing the user to freely enter or modify search criteria to look up a specific card.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user is on the Credit Card Detail screen and has submitted the screen with an Account ID value that is non-numeric or otherwise fails account filter validation (Account Filter is marked as NOT-OK)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system prepares the screen attributes for display after processing the invalid account input
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The cursor is automatically positioned on the Account ID input field so the user can immediately correct the invalid account number

all_rules.Rule_Name: Position Cursor on Account ID Field When Account Filter is Invalid
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the account filter value entered by the user fails numeric validation (is not a valid 11-digit number), the cursor must be automatically positioned on the Account ID input field to guide the user to correct the invalid entry.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user is on the Credit Card Detail screen and has submitted the screen without providing an Account ID value (Account Filter is marked as BLANK — field was empty, spaces, zeros, or asterisk)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system prepares the screen attributes for display after detecting the missing account input
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The cursor is automatically positioned on the Account ID input field so the user is directed to enter the required account number

all_rules.Rule_Name: Position Cursor on Account ID Field When Account Filter is Blank
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the user submits the screen without entering an Account ID (field is left blank, contains spaces, zeros, or an asterisk), the cursor must be automatically positioned on the Account ID input field to prompt the user to provide the required account information.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user is on the Credit Card Detail screen, the Account ID is valid, and the user has submitted the screen with a Card Number value that is non-numeric or otherwise fails card filter validation (Card Filter is marked as NOT-OK)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system prepares the screen attributes for display after processing the invalid card number input
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The cursor is automatically positioned on the Card Number input field so the user can immediately correct the invalid card number

all_rules.Rule_Name: Position Cursor on Card Number Field When Card Filter is Invalid
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the account filter is valid but the card number entered by the user fails numeric validation (is not a valid 16-digit number), the cursor must be automatically positioned on the Card Number input field to guide the user to correct the invalid card entry.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user is on the Credit Card Detail screen, the Account ID is valid, and the user has submitted the screen without providing a Card Number value (Card Filter is marked as BLANK — field was empty, spaces, zeros, or asterisk)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system prepares the screen attributes for display after detecting the missing card number input
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The cursor is automatically positioned on the Card Number input field so the user is directed to enter the required card number

all_rules.Rule_Name: Position Cursor on Card Number Field When Card Filter is Blank
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the account filter is valid but the user submits the screen without entering a Card Number (field is left blank, contains spaces, zeros, or an asterisk), the cursor must be automatically positioned on the Card Number input field to prompt the user to provide the required card information.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user is on the Credit Card Detail screen and both the Account ID and Card Number fields have passed all validation checks (Account Filter is not blank and not invalid, AND Card Filter is not blank and not invalid)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system prepares the screen attributes for display with no field-level errors present
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The cursor is automatically positioned on the Account ID input field as the default starting position on the screen

all_rules.Rule_Name: Default Cursor Position to Account ID Field When All Inputs Are Valid
all_rules.Rule_Description: When both the Account ID and Card Number pass all validations (neither is blank nor invalid), the cursor defaults to the Account ID field as the standard starting position on the Credit Card Detail screen, providing a consistent and predictable user experience.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user has arrived at the Card Detail screen and the last mapset used equals the Card List mapset (LIT-CCLISTMAPSET) AND the originating program is the Card List program (LIT-CCLISTPGM)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The screen field color attributes are being set up for display
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The Account ID field (ACCTSIDC) is set to default color (DFHDFCOL) AND the Card Number field (CARDSIDC) is set to default color (DFHDFCOL)

all_rules.Rule_Name: Set Account and Card Fields to Default Color When Arriving from Card List Screen
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the user navigates to the Card Detail screen from the Card List screen, both the Account ID and Card Number display fields are reset to their default color, providing a neutral visual baseline before any validation-based color overrides are applied.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The screen field color attributes are being set up for display and the Account filter has been flagged as invalid (FLG-ACCTFILTER-NOT-OK is TRUE) due to a failed validation check on the Account ID
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system applies visual error indicators to screen fields
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The Account ID field color (ACCTSIDC) is set to red (DFHRED) to visually indicate an invalid account entry to the user

all_rules.Rule_Name: Highlight Account ID Field in Red When Account Filter is Invalid
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the Account ID entered by the user fails validation (e.g., non-numeric value or other invalid input), the Account ID field is highlighted in red to visually alert the user that the account information requires correction, regardless of the navigation source.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The screen field color attributes are being set up for display and the Card filter has been flagged as invalid (FLG-CARDFILTER-NOT-OK is TRUE) due to a failed validation check on the Card Number
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system applies visual error indicators to screen fields
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The Card Number field color (CARDSIDC) is set to red (DFHRED) to visually indicate an invalid card number entry to the user

all_rules.Rule_Name: Highlight Card Number Field in Red When Card Filter is Invalid
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the Card Number entered by the user fails validation (e.g., non-numeric value or other invalid input), the Card Number field is highlighted in red to visually alert the user that the card information requires correction, regardless of the navigation source.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user has arrived from the Card List screen (last mapset equals LIT-CCLISTMAPSET AND originating program equals LIT-CCLISTPGM), causing both Account ID and Card Number fields to be set to default color, AND the Account ID filter is also flagged as invalid (FLG-ACCTFILTER-NOT-OK is TRUE)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system sequentially applies first the default color and then the validation-based color overrides
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The Account ID field color (ACCTSIDC) is ultimately set to red (DFHRED), overriding the previously applied default color, so the user sees the error indication

all_rules.Rule_Name: Red Highlight Overrides Default Color for Invalid Account When Arriving from Card List
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the user arrives from the Card List screen, both fields are initially set to default color. However, if the Account ID is subsequently found to be invalid, the red highlight is applied on top of the default color, ensuring that validation errors are always visually communicated even when the navigation source is the Card List screen.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user has arrived from the Card List screen (last mapset equals LIT-CCLISTMAPSET AND originating program equals LIT-CCLISTPGM), causing both Account ID and Card Number fields to be set to default color, AND the Card Number filter is also flagged as invalid (FLG-CARDFILTER-NOT-OK is TRUE)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system sequentially applies first the default color and then the validation-based color overrides
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The Card Number field color (CARDSIDC) is ultimately set to red (DFHRED), overriding the previously applied default color, so the user sees the error indication

all_rules.Rule_Name: Red Highlight Overrides Default Color for Invalid Card Number When Arriving from Card List
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the user arrives from the Card List screen, both fields are initially set to default color. However, if the Card Number is subsequently found to be invalid, the red highlight is applied on top of the default color, ensuring that validation errors are always visually communicated even when the navigation source is the Card List screen.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The Credit Card Detail screen is being displayed and the user has NOT previously submitted the screen (i.e., the program state is NOT re-entry mode)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The screen attributes are being set up for display
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: No asterisk character is placed in the Account Number field, no asterisk character is placed in the Card Number field, and no red highlighting is applied to either field due to blank field detection

all_rules.Rule_Name: No Blank Field Highlighting on First-Time Screen Display
all_rules.Rule_Description: When a user is viewing the Credit Card Detail screen for the first time (not re-entering after a submission), no asterisk or red highlighting is applied to any input fields, regardless of their content.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user is re-entering the Credit Card Detail screen after a previous submission (program is in re-entry mode) AND the Account Number field was left blank (Account filter blank flag is set)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The screen display attributes are being prepared before sending the screen to the user
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: An asterisk character ('*') is displayed in the Account Number field AND the Account Number field is highlighted in red color to indicate to the user that the Account Number is required and must be provided

all_rules.Rule_Name: Blank Account Number Field Red Highlight on Re-Entry
all_rules.Rule_Description: When a user re-submits the Credit Card Detail screen without providing an Account Number, the Account Number field is marked with an asterisk and highlighted in red to visually indicate that the field is required and was left blank.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user is re-entering the Credit Card Detail screen after a previous submission (program is in re-entry mode) AND the Account Number field contains a value (Account filter blank flag is NOT set)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The screen display attributes are being prepared before sending the screen to the user
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: No asterisk character is placed in the Account Number field and no red highlighting is applied to the Account Number field due to blank field detection (other validation-based color changes may still apply independently)

all_rules.Rule_Name: Account Number Field Unchanged When Value Present on Re-Entry
all_rules.Rule_Description: When a user re-submits the Credit Card Detail screen and the Account Number field contains a value (is not blank), no asterisk or red highlighting is applied to the Account Number field.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user is re-entering the Credit Card Detail screen after a previous submission (program is in re-entry mode) AND the Card Number field was left blank (Card filter blank flag is set)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The screen display attributes are being prepared before sending the screen to the user
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: An asterisk character ('*') is displayed in the Card Number field AND the Card Number field is highlighted in red color to indicate to the user that the Card Number is required and must be provided

all_rules.Rule_Name: Blank Card Number Field Red Highlight on Re-Entry
all_rules.Rule_Description: When a user re-submits the Credit Card Detail screen without providing a Card Number, the Card Number field is marked with an asterisk and highlighted in red to visually indicate that the field is required and was left blank.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user is re-entering the Credit Card Detail screen after a previous submission (program is in re-entry mode) AND the Card Number field contains a value (Card filter blank flag is NOT set)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The screen display attributes are being prepared before sending the screen to the user
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: No asterisk character is placed in the Card Number field and no red highlighting is applied to the Card Number field due to blank field detection (other validation-based color changes may still apply independently)

all_rules.Rule_Name: Card Number Field Unchanged When Value Present on Re-Entry
all_rules.Rule_Description: When a user re-submits the Credit Card Detail screen and the Card Number field contains a value (is not blank), no asterisk or red highlighting is applied to the Card Number field.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The Credit Card Detail screen (CCRDSLAO) is being prepared for display and the informational message field (WS-INFO-MSG) contains no active informational message (WS-NO-INFO-MESSAGE condition is TRUE)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The screen display attributes for the informational message area (INFOMSGC of CCRDSLAO) are being set during screen setup
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The informational message area on the screen must be assigned a dark or dimmed color attribute (DFHBMDAR) so that the area appears visually subdued, signaling to the user that no informational message is currently available

all_rules.Rule_Name: Dim Info Message Area When No Informational Message Exists
all_rules.Rule_Description: When there is no informational message available to display on the Credit Card Detail screen, the informational message area must be rendered in a dark or dimmed visual style to clearly indicate to the user that no informational content is present in that area.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The Credit Card Detail screen (CCRDSLAO) is being prepared for display and the informational message field (WS-INFO-MSG) contains an active informational message (WS-NO-INFO-MESSAGE condition is FALSE)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The screen display attributes for the informational message area (INFOMSGC of CCRDSLAO) are being set during screen setup
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The informational message area on the screen must be assigned a neutral color attribute (DFHNEUTR) so that the area appears visually prominent and readable, signaling to the user that an informational message is currently present and should be read

all_rules.Rule_Name: Display Info Message Area in Neutral Color When an Informational Message Is Present
all_rules.Rule_Description: When an informational message is available to display on the Credit Card Detail screen, the informational message area must be rendered in a neutral visual style to clearly indicate to the user that active informational content is present and readable in that area.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The credit card detail screen transmission process has been initiated and the system is preparing to display the screen to the user
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The screen transmission step (1400-SEND-SCREEN) is executed
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The current credit card detail screen map name (LIT-THISMAP) must be recorded as the next map destination (CCARD-NEXT-MAP), and the current credit card detail screen mapset name (LIT-THISMAPSET) must be recorded as the next mapset destination (CCARD-NEXT-MAPSET), so that the application retains the correct screen context for subsequent navigation

all_rules.Rule_Name: Record Current Screen as Next Navigation Destination
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the credit card detail screen is about to be transmitted to the user terminal, the system records the current screen's map name and mapset name as the designated next navigation destination, ensuring the application knows which screen to return to on the next user interaction.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The credit card detail screen is being prepared for transmission to the user terminal
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The screen transmission step (1400-SEND-SCREEN) is executed prior to sending the screen
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The program state indicator (CDEMO-PGM-REENTER) must be set to TRUE, so that the next user interaction with this screen is processed as a re-entry, triggering input validation (2000-PROCESS-INPUTS) rather than a fresh program entry flow

all_rules.Rule_Name: Mark Program State as Re-Enter for Next User Interaction
all_rules.Rule_Description: Immediately before sending the credit card detail screen to the user, the program state flag must be set to RE-ENTER mode. This ensures that when the user next interacts with the screen (e.g., presses ENTER), the system correctly identifies the interaction as a return to an already-displayed screen and routes processing through the input validation and data retrieval path rather than the initial entry path.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The credit card detail screen output area (CCRDSLAO) has been fully populated with account ID, card number, card embossed name, expiry month, expiry year, card active status, error messages, informational messages, current date, current time, transaction name, and program name; and screen field attributes (colors, protection, cursor position) have been set based on validation outcomes
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The screen transmission command is issued using the recorded next map (CCARD-NEXT-MAP) and next mapset (CCARD-NEXT-MAPSET) with the CURSOR option
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The formatted screen (CCRDSLAO) must be sent to the user terminal with the cursor automatically placed on the input field designated during screen attribute setup (Account ID field if account is invalid or blank; Card Number field if card is invalid or blank; otherwise defaulting to Account ID field), allowing the user to immediately interact with the correct field

all_rules.Rule_Name: Send Formatted Credit Card Detail Screen with Cursor Positioned on Relevant Input Field
all_rules.Rule_Description: The fully formatted credit card detail screen, containing all populated data fields (account ID, card number, card name, expiry month, expiry year, card status, error messages, info messages, date, time, titles), must be transmitted to the user's terminal. The cursor must be automatically positioned on the relevant input field as determined by the screen attribute setup (e.g., on the Account ID field if it is in error or blank, on the Card Number field if it is in error or blank, or defaulting to the Account ID field).

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The credit card detail screen is being transmitted to the user terminal and the terminal may currently be displaying a previous screen with locked keyboard
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The screen transmission command is issued with the ERASE and FREEKB options
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: All previously displayed content on the user terminal screen must be completely erased and replaced with the new credit card detail screen content, and the terminal keyboard must be unlocked (freed) so the user can immediately enter data or press function keys (ENTER or PF3) to interact with the screen

all_rules.Rule_Name: Clear Previous Screen Content and Unlock Keyboard for User Interaction
all_rules.Rule_Description: When transmitting the credit card detail screen, any previously displayed screen content on the user's terminal must be fully erased and replaced with the new screen content. Additionally, the terminal keyboard must be unlocked (freed) after the screen is sent, enabling the user to type input or press function keys to interact with the newly displayed credit card detail screen.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The Credit Card Detail Search Screen has been previously displayed to the user and the user has submitted the screen by pressing ENTER
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system detects that the program is in a re-entry state (the user is returning to the program after the screen was sent to them for input)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system initiates the input processing sequence, beginning with receiving the data the user entered on the Credit Card Detail Search Screen, followed by validating those inputs

all_rules.Rule_Name: Trigger User Input Reception on Screen Re-Entry
all_rules.Rule_Description: When a user re-enters the Credit Card Detail Search Screen after having previously been presented with it, the system recognises this as a re-entry event and initiates the input processing workflow to handle the submitted data.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user has submitted the Credit Card Detail Search Screen with data entered in the Account ID and/or Card Number fields
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system executes the receive map operation for the Credit Card Detail Search Screen (map: CCRDSLAI, mapset: CCRDSLAO)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: All user-entered field values from the Credit Card Detail Search Screen — including the Account ID field (ACCTSIDI) and the Card Number field (CARDSIDI) — are captured and stored in the screen input area (CCRDSLAI) and made available for subsequent input validation processing

all_rules.Rule_Name: Receive User-Entered Data from Credit Card Detail Search Screen
all_rules.Rule_Description: The system reads and captures all data entered by the user on the Credit Card Detail Search Screen into the designated screen input area so that it can be subsequently validated and processed.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The system has successfully received the user's submitted data from the Credit Card Detail Search Screen
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The receive map operation completes and the input data is stored in the screen input area (CCRDSLAI)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The Account ID value entered by the user is available in the Account ID input field (ACCTSIDI of CCRDSLAI) and the Card Number value entered by the user is available in the Card Number input field (CARDSIDI of CCRDSLAI), and the system proceeds to the input validation step (2200-EDIT-MAP-INPUTS)

all_rules.Rule_Name: Store Received Input Data in Screen Input Area for Processing
all_rules.Rule_Description: Once the user's submitted data is received from the Credit Card Detail Search Screen, it is held in the screen input area (CCRDSLAI) as the authoritative source of the user's input values, ready to be passed to the validation step.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user's submitted data has been received from the Credit Card Detail Search Screen and stored in the screen input area (CCRDSLAI)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The receive map step completes successfully
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system automatically proceeds to the input validation step (2200-EDIT-MAP-INPUTS) to validate the Account ID and Card Number values entered by the user, without any further user interaction required at this stage

all_rules.Rule_Name: Proceed to Input Validation After Data Reception
all_rules.Rule_Description: After the user's input data has been received and stored from the Credit Card Detail Search Screen, the system immediately proceeds to validate the captured input values before any data retrieval is attempted.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A user is on the Credit Card Detail screen and has submitted the input form with data in the Account ID field
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The Account ID field contains an asterisk ('*') OR contains only spaces
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The Account ID value is cleared and set to an internal blank/empty state (low-values) to indicate no account filter was provided; if the Account ID field contains any other value, it is retained exactly as entered by the user and carried forward for validation

all_rules.Rule_Name: Account ID Input Field Normalization
all_rules.Rule_Description: When a user enters an asterisk or leaves the Account ID field blank (spaces) on the card detail screen, the system standardizes the field value to an internal empty state so that downstream validation logic can consistently detect a missing or cleared Account ID.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A user is on the Credit Card Detail screen and has submitted the input form with data in the Card Number field
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The Card Number field contains an asterisk ('*') OR contains only spaces
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The Card Number value is cleared and set to an internal blank/empty state (low-values) to indicate no card filter was provided; if the Card Number field contains any other value, it is retained exactly as entered by the user and carried forward for validation

all_rules.Rule_Name: Card Number Input Field Normalization
all_rules.Rule_Description: When a user enters an asterisk or leaves the Card Number field blank (spaces) on the card detail screen, the system standardizes the field value to an internal empty state so that downstream validation logic can consistently detect a missing or cleared Card Number.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The account number validation process is initiated for a user-submitted screen
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The validation routine begins before any account number checks are performed
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The Account Filter status is set to 'NOT OK' (invalid) by default, ensuring no account is considered valid unless it explicitly passes all validation checks

all_rules.Rule_Name: Account Filter Default State Initialization
all_rules.Rule_Description: At the start of account number validation, the account filter is pre-set to an invalid state before any checks are performed, ensuring that only explicitly validated accounts are marked as valid.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A user submits the card detail screen with the Account Number field
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The Account Number field contains low-values (empty), spaces, or a numeric value of zero
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system sets the Input Error flag to TRUE and marks the Account Filter status as 'BLANK', indicating that a required account number was not provided

all_rules.Rule_Name: Account Number Missing or Zero Detection
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the user submits the screen without providing an account number, or provides a zero value, the system detects the missing input and flags it as a blank account filter error, triggering an input error condition.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The Account Number field has been determined to be blank or zero, triggering an input error
Acceptance_Criteria.When: No prior error or return message has already been set for this screen interaction (message flag is OFF)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system sets the return message to prompt the user to enter an account number (WS-PROMPT-FOR-ACCT message is activated); if a message was already set, no new message is assigned and the existing message is preserved

all_rules.Rule_Name: Account Number Missing - Prompt Message Assignment
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the account number is found to be blank or zero, the system sets a user-facing prompt message to guide the user to enter an account number, but only if no prior error or return message has already been set during this processing cycle.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The Account Number field has been determined to be blank or zero
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The blank account validation path is executed
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The Account ID stored in the session communication area (CDEMO-ACCT-ID) is set to zeroes, removing any previously held account value, and account number validation ends immediately without further checks

all_rules.Rule_Name: Account ID Cleared from Session When Blank
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the account number is blank or zero, the previously stored Account ID in the session context is cleared to zero, ensuring no stale or invalid account data persists in the session for subsequent processing.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The Account Number field contains a non-blank, non-zero value that has passed the blank/zero check
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The value entered in the Account Number field contains one or more non-numeric characters (i.e., is not a purely numeric value)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system sets the Input Error flag to TRUE and marks the Account Filter status as 'NOT OK' (invalid format), indicating the account number format is unacceptable

all_rules.Rule_Name: Account Number Non-Numeric Value Detection
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the user provides an account number that contains non-numeric characters, the system detects the invalid format and flags both an input error and the account filter as invalid, preventing a data lookup with a malformed account number.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The Account Number field contains a non-numeric value, triggering an input error
Acceptance_Criteria.When: No prior error or return message has already been set for this screen interaction (message flag is OFF)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system sets the error message to 'ACCOUNT FILTER,IF SUPPLIED MUST BE A 11 DIGIT NUMBER' to inform the user of the correct format requirement; if a message was already set, no new message is assigned and the existing message is preserved

all_rules.Rule_Name: Account Number Non-Numeric - Error Message Assignment
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the account number contains non-numeric characters, the system assigns a specific business error message informing the user that the account number must be an 11-digit numeric value, but only if no prior error message has already been set during this processing cycle.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The Account Number field has been determined to contain a non-numeric value
