Acceptance_Criteria.When: The non-numeric account validation error path is executed
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The Account ID stored in the session communication area (CDEMO-ACCT-ID) is set to zero, removing any previously held account value, and account number validation ends immediately without further checks

all_rules.Rule_Name: Account ID Cleared from Session When Non-Numeric
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the account number is found to be non-numeric, the previously stored Account ID in the session context is cleared to zero, ensuring no invalid account data persists in the session for subsequent processing.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The Account Number field contains a value that is non-blank, non-zero, and consists entirely of numeric digits
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The account number successfully passes both the blank/zero check and the numeric format check
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The validated Account Number is stored in the session communication area (CDEMO-ACCT-ID) for use in subsequent card data lookup, and the Account Filter status is marked as 'VALID' (FLG-ACCTFILTER-ISVALID), allowing the card retrieval process to proceed

all_rules.Rule_Name: Valid Account Number Stored in Session
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the account number passes all validation checks (non-blank, non-zero, and fully numeric), it is accepted as a valid account filter, stored in the session context for use in card data retrieval, and the account filter is marked as valid for downstream processing.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The card number validation process is initiated for a user-submitted card number
Acceptance_Criteria.When: Validation begins before any checks are performed
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The Card Filter status flag is set to NOT-OK (invalid) by default, ensuring no card number is considered valid unless it explicitly passes all validation checks

all_rules.Rule_Name: Default Card Filter Status to Invalid at Start of Validation
all_rules.Rule_Description: At the beginning of card number validation, the card filter status is pre-set to invalid/not-ok as a default defensive posture, ensuring that only explicitly validated card numbers are marked as acceptable.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A user submits the card detail screen with the Card Number field
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The Card Number field contains LOW-VALUES (empty), SPACES, or a numeric value of ZERO
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The overall input status is marked as ERROR, the Card Filter flag is set to BLANK (indicating missing value), and the Card Number in the session communication area is cleared to zero

all_rules.Rule_Name: Detect Missing or Empty Card Number
all_rules.Rule_Description: When a user submits the card detail screen without entering a card number, or enters only spaces, asterisks (treated as blank upstream), or zero, the system must detect this as a missing required value and flag it as a blank card filter error.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The Card Number field is blank or zero AND the input status has been marked as ERROR
Acceptance_Criteria.When: No error or return message has been previously set during this validation cycle (message flag is OFF)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: A prompt message is set to guide the user to enter a Card Number (WS-PROMPT-FOR-CARD is activated); if a message was already set, no new prompt message is generated and the existing message is preserved

all_rules.Rule_Name: Display Prompt Message When Card Number is Missing and No Prior Error Message Exists
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the card number is found to be blank or missing, the system should prompt the user to enter a card number — but only if no other error message has already been set for the current interaction, preventing overwriting of a higher-priority message.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The Card Number field has been identified as blank, spaces, or zero
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The blank card number validation path is executed
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The Card Number value in the session communication area (CDEMO-CARD-NUM) is set to ZERO, ensuring no residual card number data persists in the session

all_rules.Rule_Name: Clear Card Number in Communication Area When Card is Blank
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the card number is determined to be blank or missing, the card number stored in the session communication area must be cleared to zero to prevent stale or invalid data from being carried forward in the session.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The Card Number field contains a non-blank, non-zero value
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The entered Card Number contains one or more non-numeric characters (i.e., it is NOT NUMERIC)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The overall input status is marked as ERROR, the Card Filter flag is set to NOT-OK (invalid), and the Card Number in the session communication area (CDEMO-CARD-NUM) is cleared to ZERO

all_rules.Rule_Name: Reject Non-Numeric Card Number Entry
all_rules.Rule_Description: A card number that contains non-numeric characters is invalid. The system must reject such entries, mark the card filter as invalid, and prevent the value from being stored in the session.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The Card Number field contains a non-numeric value AND the input status has been marked as ERROR
Acceptance_Criteria.When: No error or return message has been previously set during this validation cycle (message flag is OFF)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The error message 'CARD ID FILTER,IF SUPPLIED MUST BE A 16 DIGIT NUMBER' is set as the return message to be displayed to the user; if a message was already set, no new message is generated and the existing message is preserved

all_rules.Rule_Name: Display Specific Error Message for Non-Numeric Card Number When No Prior Message Exists
all_rules.Rule_Description: When a non-numeric card number is entered, the user must be informed with a specific business error message stating the card number format requirement — but only if no other error message has already been set during this validation cycle.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The Card Number field contains a non-blank, non-zero value
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The entered Card Number is confirmed to be NUMERIC
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The numeric Card Number value (CC-CARD-NUM-N) is stored in the session communication area (CDEMO-CARD-NUM), and the Card Filter flag is set to VALID (FLG-CARDFILTER-ISVALID), indicating the card number is acceptable for card data lookup

all_rules.Rule_Name: Accept and Store Valid Numeric Card Number
all_rules.Rule_Description: When a card number passes all validation checks (non-blank and numeric), it is accepted as valid, stored in the session communication area for use in card data retrieval, and the card filter is flagged as valid.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A user is on the Credit Card Detail screen and has submitted the search form
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The Account Number field contains '*', spaces, or is entirely empty (zero value)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system treats the Account Number as blank, clears the internal Account Number value to empty, sets the Account Filter Blank flag to TRUE, sets an overall Input Error condition to TRUE, clears the stored Account ID to zero, and prompts the user to provide an account number

all_rules.Rule_Name: Detect Blank Account Number Input
all_rules.Rule_Description: When a user enters '*' or leaves the Account Number field empty on the card detail screen, the system treats the Account Number as not provided and flags it as blank for cross-field validation purposes.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A user is on the Credit Card Detail screen and has submitted the search form
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The Card Number field contains '*', spaces, or is entirely empty (zero value)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system treats the Card Number as blank, clears the internal Card Number value to empty, sets the Card Filter Blank flag to TRUE, sets an overall Input Error condition to TRUE, clears the stored Card Number to zero, and prompts the user to provide a card number

all_rules.Rule_Name: Detect Blank Card Number Input
all_rules.Rule_Description: When a user enters '*' or leaves the Card Number field empty on the card detail screen, the system treats the Card Number as not provided and flags it as blank for cross-field validation purposes.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A user is on the Credit Card Detail screen and has submitted the search form, and the Account Number field has been determined to be blank (Account Filter Blank flag is TRUE)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The Card Number field is also determined to be blank (Card Filter Blank flag is also TRUE), meaning neither an Account Number nor a Card Number has been provided
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system sets the 'No Search Criteria Received' condition to TRUE, indicating that the user must supply at least one valid search value before the card detail lookup can proceed

all_rules.Rule_Name: Enforce Minimum Search Criteria - Both Fields Blank
all_rules.Rule_Description: The system requires that at least one search criterion — either an Account Number or a Card Number — must be provided before a card detail lookup can be performed. If both fields are left blank, the system sets a 'No Search Criteria Received' error condition to prevent a meaningless search from being executed.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A user is on the Credit Card Detail screen and has submitted the search form
Acceptance_Criteria.When: At least one of the following is true: the Account Number field contains a non-blank, non-zero value (Account Filter Blank flag is FALSE), OR the Card Number field contains a non-blank, non-zero value (Card Filter Blank flag is FALSE)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system does NOT set the 'No Search Criteria Received' condition, the cross-field validation passes without a combined-blank error, and processing continues to the card data retrieval step

all_rules.Rule_Name: Allow Search When At Least One Criterion Is Provided
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the user has provided at least one valid search value — either an Account Number or a Card Number — the cross-field blank check is satisfied and the system proceeds without setting the 'No Search Criteria Received' error, allowing the card detail retrieval to continue.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A Card Number has been provided and validated as a 16-digit numeric value, and a card record retrieval process has been initiated
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system performs a lookup against the Card Data File (CARDDAT) using the Card Number as the primary search key
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system submits the Card Number as the exact key to retrieve the matching card record from the Card Data File, returning the full card record if a match exists

all_rules.Rule_Name: Card Record Lookup Using Card Number as Search Key
all_rules.Rule_Description: When a card record retrieval is initiated, the system uses the Card Number provided by the user as the primary search key to look up the corresponding record in the Card Data File (CARDDAT).

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A lookup has been performed against the Card Data File using the Card Number as the search key
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The Card Data File returns a matching card record successfully
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system retrieves and makes available the following card details for screen display: Card Holder Embossed Name, Card Expiration Month, Card Expiration Year, and Card Active Status

all_rules.Rule_Name: Successful Card Record Retrieval and Data Population
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the Card Data File successfully returns a record matching the provided Card Number, the system retrieves and stores all card details including the card holder name, expiration month, expiration year, and active status for display on the screen.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The Card Data File has returned a matching card record for the provided Card Number
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system processes the successful retrieval response
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system sets the 'Found Cards for Account' indicator to TRUE, signaling that card details are available and ready to be displayed on the card detail screen

all_rules.Rule_Name: Mark Card as Successfully Found for Screen Display
all_rules.Rule_Description: When a card record is successfully retrieved from the Card Data File, the system sets a 'Card Found' indicator so that downstream screen-building logic knows to display the retrieved card details to the user.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A lookup has been performed against the Card Data File using the Card Number as the search key
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The Card Data File returns a 'Record Not Found' response, meaning no card record exists for the given Account and Card Number combination
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system sets the Account Number field error flag (FLG-ACCTFILTER-NOT-OK) to TRUE, which will cause the Account Number field to be highlighted in red on the screen

all_rules.Rule_Name: Account Number Field Error Flag on Card Not Found
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the Card Data File does not find a record matching the provided Card Number, the system sets an error flag on the Account Number field, indicating that the Account Number is part of the invalid combination and must be visually highlighted as an error on screen.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A lookup has been performed against the Card Data File using the Card Number as the search key
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The Card Data File returns a 'Record Not Found' response, meaning no card record exists for the given Account and Card Number combination
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system sets the Card Number field error flag (FLG-CARDFILTER-NOT-OK) to TRUE, which will cause the Card Number field to be highlighted in red on the screen, and the overall input error flag is set to TRUE to prevent further processing

all_rules.Rule_Name: Card Number Field Error Flag on Card Not Found
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the Card Data File does not find a record matching the provided Card Number, the system also sets an error flag on the Card Number field, indicating that the Card Number is part of the invalid combination and must be visually highlighted as an error on screen.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The Card Data File has returned a 'Record Not Found' response for the provided Card Number, and no other error message has been set earlier in the current processing cycle (return message is currently off/blank)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system processes the not-found condition
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system sets the return message to indicate that the Account and Card Number combination was not found (DID-NOT-FIND-ACCTCARD-COMBO message), which is then displayed in the error message area at the bottom of the card detail screen

all_rules.Rule_Name: Account and Card Number Combination Not Found Error Message
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the Card Data File does not find a record for the provided Card Number, and no prior error message has already been set in the current session, the system sets a user-facing message indicating that the specific Account and Card Number combination does not exist in the system.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A card record lookup has been performed using the provided Card Number as the search key against the card file
Acceptance_Criteria.When: No card record exists in the card file matching the provided Card Number
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The overall input status must be set to INPUT-ERROR, indicating that the user-submitted data has failed validation and the screen must be re-displayed with error indicators

all_rules.Rule_Name: Mark Overall Input as Error When Card Record Not Found
all_rules.Rule_Description: When a card record lookup is performed using the provided Account ID and Card Number combination and no matching record is found, the overall input state must be flagged as an error to prevent further processing and trigger error display on screen.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A card record lookup has been performed using the provided Card Number as the search key and the overall input has been flagged as an error
Acceptance_Criteria.When: No card record exists in the card file matching the provided Card Number
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The Account ID filter flag must be set to NOT-OK (FLG-ACCTFILTER-NOT-OK), which will cause the Account ID field to be highlighted in red on the screen

all_rules.Rule_Name: Flag Account Filter as Invalid When Card Record Not Found
all_rules.Rule_Description: When no card record is found for the given Account ID and Card Number combination, the Account ID filter must be marked as invalid so that the Account ID field is visually highlighted in red on the screen to alert the user.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A card record lookup has been performed using the provided Card Number as the search key and the Account ID filter has already been flagged as NOT-OK
Acceptance_Criteria.When: No card record exists in the card file matching the provided Card Number
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The Card Number filter flag must be set to NOT-OK (FLG-CARDFILTER-NOT-OK), which will cause the Card Number field to be highlighted in red on the screen

all_rules.Rule_Name: Flag Card Number Filter as Invalid When Card Record Not Found
all_rules.Rule_Description: When no card record is found for the given Account ID and Card Number combination, the Card Number filter must also be marked as invalid so that the Card Number field is visually highlighted in red on the screen to alert the user.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A card record lookup has been performed, no matching card record was found, both Account ID and Card Number filters have been flagged as invalid, AND no error message has previously been set for display (WS-RETURN-MSG-OFF is TRUE)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system checks whether an error message is already present
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The message flag DID-NOT-FIND-ACCTCARD-COMBO must be set to TRUE, which populates the screen error message area with the 'Account and Card Number Combination Not Found' message to inform the user that the entered combination does not exist in the system

all_rules.Rule_Name: Display Account and Card Number Combination Not Found Message When No Prior Error Message Exists
all_rules.Rule_Description: When no card record is found for the given Account ID and Card Number combination, and no prior error message has already been set for display, the system must set a specific business message informing the user that the Account and Card Number combination does not exist.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A card record lookup has been performed, no matching card record was found, both Account ID and Card Number filters have been flagged as invalid, AND an error message has already been set for display earlier in the processing cycle (WS-RETURN-MSG-OFF is FALSE)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system checks whether an error message is already present
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The existing error message must be retained as-is without modification — the 'Account and Card Number Combination Not Found' message flag (DID-NOT-FIND-ACCTCARD-COMBO) must NOT be set, preserving the previously established error message for display to the user

all_rules.Rule_Name: Retain Existing Error Message When Card Record Not Found and Prior Message Already Set
all_rules.Rule_Description: When no card record is found for the given Account ID and Card Number combination, but an error message has already been set earlier in the same processing cycle, the existing error message must be preserved and not overwritten by the 'not found' message.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A card file read operation has been attempted using the Card Number provided by the user as the search key
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The card record is successfully located and retrieved from the card file
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system marks the result status as 'Found Cards for Account', confirming that card details are available for display on the screen

all_rules.Rule_Name: Successful Card Record Retrieval Confirmation
all_rules.Rule_Description: When a card record is successfully retrieved from the card file using the provided Card Number as the search key, the system marks the retrieval result as 'Found Cards for Account', enabling the card detail fields to be populated and displayed on the screen.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The card retrieval result has been marked as 'Found Cards for Account' following a successful card file read
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system prepares the screen variables for display
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The following card details are populated on the screen: (1) Card Embossed Name — the name printed on the card, (2) Card Expiry Month — the month the card expires, (3) Card Expiry Year — the year the card expires, (4) Card Active Status — whether the card is currently active or inactive

all_rules.Rule_Name: Card Detail Fields Population on Successful Retrieval
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the card retrieval result is marked as 'Found Cards for Account', the system populates the screen with all available card details including the embossed cardholder name, card expiry month, card expiry year, and the card active status, making them visible to the user.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The system is preparing to return to the user after processing, and a return message or error message may be present in the working storage return message field (WS-RETURN-MSG)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system executes the return sequence (COMMON-RETURN) after any processing path — whether successful card retrieval, input validation failure, or any other outcome
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The current value of the working storage return message field (WS-RETURN-MSG) must be moved to the screen error message display field (CCARD-ERROR-MSG), ensuring the user sees the correct message — whether it is an error description, a prompt, or blank — on the next screen display

all_rules.Rule_Name: Error Message Propagation to Screen Display Field
all_rules.Rule_Description: Before returning control to the user, the current error or return message held in the working storage message field must be transferred to the screen's error display field so the user sees the most up-to-date status or error information on the next screen interaction.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The system is preparing to return control to CICS after completing a processing cycle, and the application-level communication area (CARDDEMO-COMMAREA) contains the current application state including account ID, card number, navigation context (from/to program and transaction), user type, and program re-entry flag
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system executes the return sequence (COMMON-RETURN)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The entire content of the application-level communication area (CARDDEMO-COMMAREA) must be placed into the beginning (first segment) of the combined outbound communication area (WS-COMMAREA), preserving all application-wide session data for the next interaction

all_rules.Rule_Name: Application-Level Communication Area Packaging
all_rules.Rule_Description: Before returning to CICS, the application-level communication area (CARDDEMO-COMMAREA), which holds shared application state such as account ID, card number, program navigation context, and user type, must be copied into the first portion of the combined outbound communication area to preserve application-wide session state across interactions.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The application-level communication area (CARDDEMO-COMMAREA) has already been placed into the first segment of the combined communication area (WS-COMMAREA), and the program-specific communication area (WS-THIS-PROGCOMMAREA) contains state data specific to this card detail screen
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system executes the return sequence (COMMON-RETURN) and packages the outbound communication area
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The content of the program-specific communication area (WS-THIS-PROGCOMMAREA) must be written into the combined communication area (WS-COMMAREA) starting at the position immediately after the end of the application commarea — specifically at offset (LENGTH OF CARDDEMO-COMMAREA + 1) for a length equal to (LENGTH OF WS-THIS-PROGCOMMAREA) — so that both areas are stored contiguously without overlap for correct restoration on the next program entry

all_rules.Rule_Name: Program-Specific Communication Area Appended After Application Commarea
all_rules.Rule_Description: The program-specific communication area (WS-THIS-PROGCOMMAREA), which holds state data specific to this card detail screen program, must be appended immediately after the application-level communication area within the combined outbound communication area. The offset position is calculated as the length of the application commarea plus one, ensuring no overlap and correct retrieval on the next entry.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The combined communication area (WS-COMMAREA) has been fully packaged with both the application-level commarea and the program-specific commarea, and the current transaction ID (LIT-THISTRANID) identifies this card detail screen transaction
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system completes the return sequence (COMMON-RETURN) and issues the CICS RETURN command
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: Control must be returned to CICS with: (1) the current transaction ID (LIT-THISTRANID) specified as the next transaction to be invoked upon the user's next action, (2) the fully packaged combined communication area (WS-COMMAREA) passed as the communication area, and (3) the length of the combined communication area specified — ensuring the complete session state (application context, program-specific state, navigation history, account and card data) is preserved and available when the user next interacts with the screen

all_rules.Rule_Name: Session Continuity Preservation on Return to CICS
all_rules.Rule_Description: After packaging all session state, the system must return control to CICS specifying the current transaction ID so that the same transaction is re-invoked when the user next interacts with the screen, and passing the fully packaged combined communication area so all session context is available for the next processing cycle.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The card detail screen program is executing and evaluating the current program state or key pressed by the user
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The program state does not match any of the recognized conditions: PF3 navigation, first-time entry from Card List screen, general first-time entry, or re-entry after user submission
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system identifies the situation as an unrecognized program state and triggers the unexpected scenario handling process

all_rules.Rule_Name: Detect Unrecognized Program State
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the program encounters a condition that does not match any known or expected program state (not PF3, not first entry from Card List, not general first entry, and not re-entry), the system identifies this as an unexpected scenario and initiates error handling.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: An unrecognized program state has been detected during program execution of the card detail screen
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The unexpected scenario handling is triggered
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The current program name (this program's identifier) is recorded as the responsible source in the error tracking information

all_rules.Rule_Name: Record Responsible Program for Unexpected Scenario
all_rules.Rule_Description: When an unexpected program state is detected, the system records the name of the currently executing program as the source responsible for the unexpected condition, enabling traceability of the issue.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: An unrecognized program state has been detected and the responsible program has been identified
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The unexpected scenario handling assigns a classification code
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The error code is set to '0001' to specifically flag and classify this condition as an unexpected data scenario

all_rules.Rule_Name: Assign Error Code for Unexpected Scenario
all_rules.Rule_Description: When an unexpected program state is encountered, the system assigns the specific error code '0001' to uniquely identify and classify this type of unexpected data scenario for downstream error tracking and reporting.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: An unrecognized program state has been detected and error code '0001' has been assigned
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system prepares the error context for the unexpected scenario
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: Any previously stored error reason detail is cleared to blank spaces so that no prior unrelated error reason is associated with this unexpected scenario

all_rules.Rule_Name: Clear Prior Error Reason to Avoid Misleading Context
all_rules.Rule_Description: When handling an unexpected program state, any previously recorded error reason is cleared (set to blank spaces) to ensure that stale or unrelated error context from prior operations does not mislead the error record for this new unexpected scenario.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: An unrecognized program state has been detected, the responsible program has been recorded, error code '0001' has been assigned, and prior error reason has been cleared
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system prepares the message to be shown to the user
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The return message displayed to the user is set to the exact text 'UNEXPECTED DATA SCENARIO'

all_rules.Rule_Name: Set User-Facing Error Message for Unexpected Scenario
all_rules.Rule_Description: When an unexpected program state is encountered, the system sets the error message to the specific text 'UNEXPECTED DATA SCENARIO' which will be presented to the user to communicate that an unrecognized condition has occurred.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The error message has been set to 'UNEXPECTED DATA SCENARIO' and all error tracking fields have been populated
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system sends the error information to the user
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The 'UNEXPECTED DATA SCENARIO' message is displayed as plain text on the user's terminal screen and the program ends, preventing any further processing under the unrecognized state

all_rules.Rule_Name: Display Unexpected Scenario Error Message to User
all_rules.Rule_Description: After setting the 'UNEXPECTED DATA SCENARIO' error message, the system immediately displays this message as plain text on the user's terminal screen and terminates the current program execution, ensuring the user is informed of the unrecoverable unexpected condition.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user has submitted the Card Detail screen with an Account Number field value
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The Account Number field contains an asterisk ('*') OR contains only spaces (i.e., no meaningful value was entered)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The Account Number is set to a blank indicator (LOW-VALUES), signaling that no account number was provided; if the Account Number field contains any other value, the entered Account Number is retained as-is for further validation processing

all_rules.Rule_Name: Normalize Account Number Input - Replace Asterisk or Spaces with Blank Indicator
all_rules.Rule_Description: When a user enters an asterisk ('*') or leaves the Account Number field blank (spaces) on the Card Detail screen, the system treats the field as if no account number was provided by setting it to a blank indicator value. If a value other than asterisk or spaces is entered, the system retains the entered Account Number for subsequent validation.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user has submitted the Card Detail screen with a Card Number field value
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The Card Number field contains an asterisk ('*') OR contains only spaces (i.e., no meaningful value was entered)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The Card Number is set to a blank indicator (LOW-VALUES), signaling that no card number was provided; if the Card Number field contains any other value, the entered Card Number is retained as-is for further validation processing

all_rules.Rule_Name: Normalize Card Number Input - Replace Asterisk or Spaces with Blank Indicator
all_rules.Rule_Description: When a user enters an asterisk ('*') or leaves the Card Number field blank (spaces) on the Card Detail screen, the system treats the field as if no card number was provided by setting it to a blank indicator value. If a value other than asterisk or spaces is entered, the system retains the entered Card Number for subsequent validation.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The account number validation process is about to begin for any user-entered Account Number
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The account validation routine is invoked
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The account filter status flag must be immediately set to 'Not OK / Invalid' as the default state, before any value checks are performed

all_rules.Rule_Name: Default Account Filter Status Set to Invalid Before Validation
all_rules.Rule_Description: Before any account number validation begins, the account filter status is always preset to Invalid as a safety default, ensuring that only explicitly validated accounts are marked as valid.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A user has submitted the card detail screen with the Account Number field
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The Account Number field contains blank spaces, low-values (empty), or a numeric value of zero
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system must set the overall Input Error flag to TRUE and set the Account Filter status to 'Blank', indicating that a required account value was not provided

all_rules.Rule_Name: Account Number Blank or Zero Triggers Input Error and Blank Flag
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the Account Number field is submitted without a value (blank, spaces, or zero), the system must flag the overall input as erroneous and specifically mark the account filter as blank, preventing any card data lookup from proceeding.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The Account Number field has been determined to be blank or zero, triggering an input error
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system checks whether an error or return message has already been set for the current screen interaction
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: If no prior message is set, the system must set a prompt message instructing the user to provide an Account Number; if a message is already set, the existing message is retained and no new prompt message is applied

all_rules.Rule_Name: Prompt Message Displayed When Account Number Is Blank and No Prior Error Message Exists
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the Account Number is blank or zero and no other error message has already been set for the screen, the system displays a prompt message instructing the user to provide an Account Number. If a prior error message already exists, the existing message is preserved and no new prompt is set.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The Account Number field has been determined to be blank or zero
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The blank account validation path completes its error flagging and message setting
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The Account ID value held in the session context (CDEMO-ACCT-ID) must be set to zero, and account validation must exit immediately without further checks

all_rules.Rule_Name: Account ID Cleared in Session When Account Number Is Blank
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the Account Number is determined to be blank or zero, the Account ID stored in the active session context must be reset to zero, ensuring no stale or invalid account value persists in the session for subsequent processing.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A user has submitted the card detail screen with a non-blank, non-zero value in the Account Number field
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The Account Number value is found to contain non-numeric characters (i.e., it is not a purely numeric value)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system must set the overall Input Error flag to TRUE and set the Account Filter status to 'Not OK / Invalid', indicating the account value fails the numeric format requirement

all_rules.Rule_Name: Non-Numeric Account Number Triggers Input Error and Invalid Flag
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the Account Number field contains a non-blank, non-zero value that is not entirely numeric, the system must flag the overall input as erroneous and mark the account filter status as Invalid, preventing any card data lookup from proceeding.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The Account Number field has been determined to contain non-numeric characters, triggering an input error
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system checks whether an error or return message has already been set for the current screen interaction
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: If no prior message is set, the system must display the error message: 'ACCOUNT FILTER, IF SUPPLIED MUST BE A 11 DIGIT NUMBER'; if a message is already set, the existing message is retained and no new error message is applied

all_rules.Rule_Name: Specific Error Message Displayed When Account Number Is Non-Numeric and No Prior Message Exists
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the Account Number contains non-numeric characters and no other error message has already been set, the system displays a specific error message informing the user that the Account Number must be an 11-digit numeric value. If a prior error message already exists, it is preserved.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The Account Number field has been determined to contain non-numeric characters
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The non-numeric account validation path completes its error flagging and message setting
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The Account ID value held in the session context (CDEMO-ACCT-ID) must be set to zero, and account validation must exit immediately without further checks

all_rules.Rule_Name: Account ID Cleared in Session When Account Number Is Non-Numeric
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the Account Number is determined to be non-numeric, the Account ID stored in the active session context must be reset to zero, ensuring no invalid account value persists in the session for subsequent processing.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A user has submitted the card detail screen with a non-blank, non-zero Account Number
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The Account Number value is confirmed to be entirely numeric, passing all validation checks
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system must store the validated Account Number into the session context (CDEMO-ACCT-ID) and set the Account Filter status to 'Valid / Is Valid', allowing the card data lookup to proceed with this account value

all_rules.Rule_Name: Valid Numeric Account Number Stored in Session and Marked as Valid
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the Account Number passes all validation checks (non-blank, non-zero, and fully numeric), it is accepted as valid, stored in the session context for use in card data retrieval, and the account filter status is marked as Valid.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The card number validation process is about to begin for a user-entered Card Number
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The card number validation routine is invoked
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The Card Filter status is set to 'Invalid' as the default starting state, ensuring no card number is assumed valid before validation is performed

all_rules.Rule_Name: Initialize Card Filter Validation Status
all_rules.Rule_Description: Before any card number validation begins, the card filter status is pre-set to invalid to ensure that only explicitly validated card numbers are accepted as valid.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A user has submitted the card detail screen with the Card Number field
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The Card Number field contains blank spaces, low-values (empty), or a numeric value of zero
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The overall input status is marked as 'Error', and the Card Filter status is specifically flagged as 'Blank' to distinguish this condition from an invalid format error

all_rules.Rule_Name: Detect Blank or Zero Card Number and Flag as Error
all_rules.Rule_Description: When a user submits the card detail screen without providing a Card Number, or provides a value that is effectively empty (spaces, low-values, or zero), the system must detect this condition and flag it as an input error with a specific 'blank' indicator.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The Card Number field has been determined to be blank or zero, triggering an input error
Acceptance_Criteria.When: No other error or return message has already been set for the current screen interaction
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: A prompt message is set instructing the user to provide a Card Number; if an error message was already set from a prior validation step, the existing message is preserved and no new prompt is generated

all_rules.Rule_Name: Display Prompt Message When Card Number is Missing
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the Card Number is found to be blank or zero, and no prior error message has already been set for the screen, the system should prompt the user to provide a Card Number. If another error message is already displayed, the existing message takes priority and is not overwritten.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The Card Number field has been determined to be blank or zero
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The blank card number condition is confirmed
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The Card Number stored in the session context (CDEMO-CARD-NUM) is set to zero, and card number validation ends immediately without further checks

all_rules.Rule_Name: Clear Card Number from Session When Blank
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the Card Number is blank or zero, any previously stored Card Number value in the session context must be cleared to zero to prevent stale data from being used in subsequent processing.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The Card Number field has been provided with a non-blank, non-zero value
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The entered Card Number contains one or more non-numeric characters
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The overall input status is marked as 'Error', and the Card Filter status is flagged as 'Invalid' (distinct from blank) to indicate a format violation

all_rules.Rule_Name: Detect Non-Numeric Card Number and Flag as Invalid
all_rules.Rule_Description: When a user provides a Card Number that contains non-numeric characters, the system must detect this as an invalid format and flag both the overall input and the card filter as erroneous.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The Card Number field has been determined to contain non-numeric characters, triggering an input error
Acceptance_Criteria.When: No other error or return message has already been set for the current screen interaction
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The error message 'CARD ID FILTER,IF SUPPLIED MUST BE A 16 DIGIT NUMBER' is set for display on the screen; if an error message was already set from a prior validation step, the existing message is preserved and the new message is not generated

all_rules.Rule_Name: Display 16-Digit Numeric Error Message for Invalid Card Number
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the Card Number is found to contain non-numeric characters, and no prior error message has already been set, the system must display a specific error message informing the user that the Card ID must be a 16-digit number. If another error message is already active, it is preserved.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The Card Number field has been determined to contain non-numeric characters
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The non-numeric card number condition is confirmed
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The Card Number stored in the session context (CDEMO-CARD-NUM) is set to zero, and card number validation ends immediately without further checks

all_rules.Rule_Name: Clear Card Number from Session When Non-Numeric
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the Card Number is found to be non-numeric, any previously stored Card Number value in the session context must be cleared to zero to prevent invalid data from being used in card lookup processing.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The Card Number field has been provided with a value that is non-blank, non-zero, and fully numeric
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The Card Number successfully passes both the blank/zero check and the numeric format check
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The numeric Card Number value is stored in the session context (CDEMO-CARD-NUM) for use in subsequent card data retrieval

all_rules.Rule_Name: Store Valid Card Number in Session Context
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the Card Number passes all validation checks (non-blank and fully numeric), the validated numeric card number value must be stored in the session context so it can be used for card record lookup.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The Card Number has been confirmed as non-blank, non-zero, and fully numeric
Acceptance_Criteria.When: All card number validation checks have passed successfully
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The Card Filter status is set to 'Valid', overriding the initial 'Invalid' default, and indicating that the card number is ready for use in card data retrieval

all_rules.Rule_Name: Flag Card Filter as Valid After Successful Validation
all_rules.Rule_Description: After a Card Number successfully passes all validation checks, the Card Filter status must be explicitly set to 'Valid' to signal downstream processing that the card number is acceptable for use in a card record lookup.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A card file lookup has been performed using the provided Card Number as the search key
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The card file returns a successful match — a card record exists for the given Card Number
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system marks the result status as 'Found Cards for Account', indicating that card details are available and the screen should proceed to display the card information including Embossed Name, Expiry Month, Expiry Year, and Active Status

all_rules.Rule_Name: Mark Card as Successfully Found
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the card file lookup completes and a matching card record is found for the provided Card Number, the system marks the retrieval result as successful so that card details can be displayed on screen.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A card file lookup has been performed using the provided Card Number as the search key
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The card file returns a 'not found' result — no card record exists for the given Card Number
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system marks the input state as an error condition, flags the Account ID filter as invalid (causing the Account ID field to be highlighted in red on screen), and flags the Card Number filter as invalid (causing the Card Number field to be highlighted in red on screen)

all_rules.Rule_Name: Flag Both Account and Card Filters as Invalid When Card Not Found
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the card file lookup finds no matching record for the provided Card Number, the system marks the overall input as erroneous and flags both the Account ID filter and the Card Number filter as invalid, triggering visual error indicators on both fields.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The card file lookup has returned a 'not found' result for the provided Card Number, AND no return message has been set yet during the current processing cycle
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system checks whether a return message is already present and finds that no message has been set
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system sets the return message to indicate that the Account and Card combination was not found, so the user is informed that the specific combination of Account ID and Card Number entered does not exist in the system

all_rules.Rule_Name: Set Account and Card Combination Not Found Message
all_rules.Rule_Description: When a card record is not found and no prior error message has already been set during the current transaction, the system sets a specific business message informing the user that the entered Account and Card combination does not exist.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The card file lookup has returned a 'not found' result for the provided Card Number, AND a return message has already been set during the current processing cycle
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system checks whether a return message is already present and finds that a message has already been set
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system does not overwrite the existing return message — the previously set error message is preserved and will be displayed to the user on the screen without modification

all_rules.Rule_Name: Preserve Existing Error Message When Card Not Found
all_rules.Rule_Description: When a card record is not found but an error message has already been set earlier in the current processing cycle, the system retains the existing message without overwriting it, ensuring the first and most relevant error message is preserved for the user.

description:
COCRDSLC is an online CICS program that accepts and processes credit card detail requests, allowing users to search for and display credit card information by account number and card number. The program handles user input validation, retrieves card records from VSAM files, and presents the card details (including card name, expiration date, and status) on a screen. It is a main/driver program that manages navigation between the credit card list screen, the detail screen, and the main menu.
- **Execution Environment**: Online (CICS) - **Database Access**: VSAM/CICS File - **MQ Calls**: No - **Module Type**: Main/Driver module
### Key Functionalities: 1: Program Initialization - Initialize working storage areas, communication areas, and set default return message to off at program start 2: Communication Area Loading - Load previously stored communication area data (account ID, card number, program context) from passed commarea if returning to this screen, or initialize fresh if coming from main menu 3: PF Key Mapping - Capture and store the function key pressed by the user (Enter or PF3) and validate it as an acceptable key for this screen 4: Invalid Key Handling - When an unsupported function key is pressed, default the action to Enter key behavior to continue normal screen processing 5: PF3 Exit Navigation - When user presses PF3, determine the calling program and transaction to return to (either the main menu or the originating program), update navigation context, and transfer control back 6: Direct Entry from Card List Screen - When arriving directly from the Credit Card List screen with pre-validated account and card number, skip input gathering and immediately retrieve card details for display 7: Initial Screen Display - When entering the screen fresh from another context (not re-entering), display the credit card detail search screen prompting the user for input without any pre-filled data 8: User Input Processing - When the user has re-entered the screen after providing input, receive and validate the entered account number and card number before attempting data retrieval 9: Screen Initialization - Set up screen header information including screen titles, transaction ID, program name, current date, and current time for display 10: Account ID Display Setup - Populate the account ID field on screen from the communication area; display low-values if account ID is zero, otherwise display the stored account number 11: Card Number Display Setup - Populate the card number field on screen from the communication area; display low-values if card number is zero, otherwise display the stored card number 12: Card Details Display - When card data has been successfully retrieved, populate the screen with card holder name, card expiration month, card expiration year, and card active status 13: Default Prompt Message - When no informational message is set, default the screen prompt to instruct the user to enter Account and Card Number 14: Error and Info Message Display - Move the return/error message and informational message to their respective screen output fields for user feedback 15: Screen Field Protection - When arriving from the Card List screen, protect (make read-only) the account ID and card number input fields; otherwise make them editable 16: Cursor Positioning - Position the cursor on the account ID field when account filter is invalid or blank, on the card number field when card filter is invalid or blank, defaulting to account ID field otherwise 17: Screen Field Color Setup - When coming from Card List screen, set account and card fields to default color; highlight account ID field in red if account filter is invalid; highlight card number field in red if card filter is invalid 18: Blank Field Red Highlight - When re-entering the screen and account or card number field was left blank, display an asterisk in the field and highlight it in red to indicate required input 19: Info Message Color - Display the informational message area in dark/dim color when no message exists, or neutral color when a message is present 20: Screen Transmission - Send the formatted credit card detail screen to the user terminal with cursor positioning and keyboard unlocked, marking program state as re-enter for next interaction 21: User Input Reception - Receive the data entered by the user from the credit card detail search screen into the input map area 22: Input Field Normalization - Replace asterisk or space values in account ID and card number input fields with low-values to standardize blank/cleared field detection 23: Account Number Validation - Validate that the account number is provided (not blank/zero) and is numeric; set appropriate error flags and messages if account number is missing or non-numeric, and store valid account number in communication area 24: Card Number Validation - Validate that the card number is provided (not blank/zero) and is numeric; set appropriate error flags and messages if card number is missing or non-numeric, and store valid card number in communication area 25: Cross-Field Validation - Check that at least one search criterion (account number or card number) has been provided; if both are blank, set a 'no search criteria received' error message 26: Card Record Retrieval by Card Number - Read the card data file using the card number as the key to retrieve the full card record including card holder name, expiration date, and active status 27: Card Not Found Handling - When the card record is not found for the given account and card number combination, set input error flags for both account and card filters and display appropriate 'not found' message to user 28: Successful Card Retrieval Confirmation - When card record is successfully read from the file, mark the result as 'found cards for account' to trigger display of card details on screen 29: Return with Context Preservation - Before returning to CICS, move the error message to the screen error field, package both the application commarea and program-specific commarea, and return with the current transaction ID for next interaction 30: Unexpected Scenario Handling - When an unrecognized program state is encountered, set an abend culprit, error code, and display an unexpected data scenario message to the user
